class CollectorRunnerWindow(QMainWindow):

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Project Reasoner v10 - Data Collector")
        self.resize(900, 600)

        self._prefs = _load_prefs()
        self._process: QProcess | None = None
        self._current_output_json: str = ""

        self._busy_frames = ["-", "\\", "|", "/"]
        self._busy_index = 0

        self._busy_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._busy_timer.setInterval(120)
        self._busy_timer.timeout.connect(self._tick_busy_animation)

        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # UI construction
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        central = QWidget()
        self.setCentralWidget(central)
        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(central)

        # Project root row
        root_row = QHBoxLayout()
        root_row.addWidget(QLabel("Project root:"))
        self.project_root_edit = QLineEdit(
            self._prefs.get("project_root", str(_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT))
        )
        root_row.addWidget(self.project_root_edit)
        self.browse_project_button = QPushButton("Browse…")
        root_row.addWidget(self.browse_project_button)
        main_layout.addLayout(root_row)

        # Output JSON row
        out_row = QHBoxLayout()
        out_row.addWidget(QLabel("Output JSON:"))
        self.output_json_edit = QLineEdit(
            self._prefs.get("output_json", str(_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON.resolve()))
        )
        out_row.addWidget(self.output_json_edit)
        self.browse_output_button = QPushButton("Browse…")
        out_row.addWidget(self.browse_output_button)
        main_layout.addLayout(out_row)

        # Button row
        button_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.run_button = QPushButton("Run Collector")
        self.close_button = QPushButton("Close")
        button_row.addWidget(self.run_button)
        button_row.addWidget(self.close_button)
        button_row.addStretch()
        main_layout.addLayout(button_row)

        self.status_label = QLabel("Idle")
        main_layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

        # Log area
        self.log_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.log_box.setReadOnly(True)
        main_layout.addWidget(self.log_box)

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.browse_project_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_project_root)
        self.browse_output_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_output_json)
        self.run_button.clicked.connect(self._run_collector)
        self.close_button.clicked.connect(self._close_application)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Slots
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _browse_project_root(self) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self, "Select project root", self.project_root_edit.text()
        )
        if folder:
            self.project_root_edit.setText(folder)
            _save_prefs(
                self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
                self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
            )

    def _close_application(self) -> None:
        self.close()

    def _browse_output_json(self) -> None:
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Select output JSON",
            self.output_json_edit.text(),
            "JSON files (*.json)",
        )
        if path:
            self.output_json_edit.setText(path)
            _save_prefs(
                self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
                self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
            )

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)
        sb = self.log_box.verticalScrollBar()
        sb.setValue(sb.maximum())

    def _create_json_file_if_missing(self, output_json: Path) -> None:
        if not output_json.exists():
            output_json.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            output_json.write_text(
                json.dumps(make_empty_index_payload(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
            )
            self._append_log(f"Created empty index file: {output_json}")

    def _start_busy_animation(self) -> None:
        self._busy_index = 0
        self.run_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.browse_project_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.browse_output_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText("Starting collector...")
        self._busy_timer.start()

    def _stop_busy_animation(self, status_text: str) -> None:
        self._busy_timer.stop()
        self.run_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.browse_project_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.browse_output_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.status_label.setText(status_text)
        self.setWindowTitle("Project Reasoner v10 - Data Collector")

    def _tick_busy_animation(self) -> None:
        frame = self._busy_frames[self._busy_index % len(self._busy_frames)]
        self._busy_index += 1
        self.status_label.setText(f"Running collector {frame}")
        self.setWindowTitle(f"Project Reasoner v10 - Data Collector {frame}")

    def _on_process_finished(self, exit_code: int, _exit_status) -> None:
        stdout_text = ""
        stderr_text = ""

        if self._process is not None:
            stdout_text = bytes(self._process.readAllStandardOutput()).decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
            stderr_text = bytes(self._process.readAllStandardError()).decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()

        if exit_code != 0:
            self._stop_busy_animation("Failed")
            self._append_log("[ERROR] Collector failed:")
            self._append_log(stderr_text or stdout_text or "Unknown child-process error")

            if has_active_runtime_scenario():
                log_runtime_error(
                    "collector_run_failed",
                    payload={"traceback": stderr_text or stdout_text or "Unknown child-process error"},
                )

            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Collector error",
                stderr_text or stdout_text or "Unknown child-process error",
            )
            return

        try:
            result = json.loads(stdout_text) if stdout_text else {}
        except Exception:
            result = {}

        file_count = int(result.get("file_count", 0))
        error_count = int(result.get("error_count", 0))

        self._stop_busy_animation("Finished")
        self._append_log(f"[OK] Done - {file_count} files indexed, {error_count} errors.")
        self._append_log(f"  Saved to: {self._current_output_json}")

        if has_active_runtime_scenario():
            log_runtime_event(
                "collector_run_finished",
                payload={
                    "file_count": file_count,
                    "error_count": error_count,
                    "output_json": self._current_output_json,
                },
            )

    def _on_process_error(self, _process_error) -> None:
        self._stop_busy_animation("Failed")
        self._append_log("[ERROR] Collector process could not start.")
        QMessageBox.critical(self, "Collector error", "Collector process could not start.")

    def _run_collector(self) -> None:
        project_root = self.project_root_edit.text().strip()
        output_json_raw = self.output_json_edit.text().strip()

        if not project_root:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Missing input", "Please set the project root.")
            return
        if not Path(project_root).is_dir():
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self, "Invalid path", f"Project root does not exist:\n{project_root}"
            )
            return

        output_json = resolve_output_json_path(output_json_raw)
        self._create_json_file_if_missing(output_json)
        self._current_output_json = str(output_json)

        _save_prefs(project_root, str(output_json))

        self._append_log("Starting collector...")
        self._append_log(f"  root : {project_root}")


        self._append_log(f"  output: {output_json}")

        if has_active_runtime_scenario():
            log_runtime_event(
                "collector_run_started",
                payload={"project_root": project_root, "output_json": str(output_json)},
            )

        runtime_trace_path = _DEFAULT_RUNTIME_TRACE_JSON.resolve()
        runtime_trace_json = str(runtime_trace_path) if runtime_trace_path.exists() else None

        if runtime_trace_json:
            self._append_log(f"  runtime_trace: {runtime_trace_json}")
        else:
            self._append_log("  runtime_trace: not found - continuing without raw runtime trace merge")

        self._process = QProcess(self)
        self._process.finished.connect(self._on_process_finished)
        self._process.errorOccurred.connect(self._on_process_error)

        process_args = [
            str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
            _CHILD_MODE_ARG,
            project_root,
            str(output_json),
            runtime_trace_json or "",
        ]

        self._start_busy_animation()
        self._process.start(sys.executable, process_args)

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        _save_prefs(
            self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
            self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
        )
        super().closeEvent(event)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Entry point
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main() -> None:
    if len(sys.argv) >= 4 and sys.argv[1] == _CHILD_MODE_ARG:
        project_root = sys.argv[2]
        output_json = sys.argv[3]
        runtime_trace_json = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) >= 5 and sys.argv[4] else None
        sys.exit(_run_collector_child(project_root, output_json, runtime_trace_json))

    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = CollectorRunnerWindow()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from PySide6.QtCore import QProcess, QTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication,
    QFileDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMainWindow,
    QMessageBox,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

import collector_main
from developer_tools.kanda_reasoner_app.runtime_scenarios.collector_scenario_traces import (
    has_active_runtime_scenario,
    log_runtime_event,
    log_runtime_error,
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent.parent

_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON = (
    Path(__file__).parent / "project_reasoner_v10_index.json"
)

_DEFAULT_RUNTIME_TRACE_JSON = (
    _DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT
    / "developer_tools"
    / "kanda_reasoner_app"
    / "reasoner_runtime_collector"
    / "outputs"
    / "runtime_trace.json"
)

_PREFS_FILE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / ".collector_runner_prefs.json"

_CHILD_MODE_ARG = "--collector-child"


def _load_prefs() -> dict:
    try:
        if _PREFS_FILE.exists():
            return json.loads(_PREFS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return {}


def _save_prefs(project_root: str, output_json: str) -> None:
    try:
        _PREFS_FILE.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "project_root": project_root,
                    "output_json": output_json,
                },
                indent=2,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
    except Exception:
        pass


def _run_collector_child(
    project_root: str,
    output_json: str,
    runtime_trace_json: str | None,
) -> int:
    try:
        result = collector_main.run_collector(
            project_root=project_root,
            output_json=output_json,
            runtime_trace_json=runtime_trace_json,
        )
        payload = {
            "ok": True,
            "file_count": len(result.get("files", [])),
            "error_count": len(result.get("errors", [])),
            "output_json": output_json,
            "has_runtime_trace_summary": "runtime_trace_summary" in result,
            "has_runtime_scenario_summary": "runtime_scenario_summary" in result,
        }
        print(json.dumps(payload), flush=True)
        return 0
    except Exception:
        print(traceback.format_exc(), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1


def make_empty_index_payload() -> dict:
    return {"files": [], "errors": [], "project_summary": {}}


def resolve_output_json_path(raw: str) -> Path:
    p = Path(raw).expanduser()
    if not p.suffix.lower().endswith(".json"):
        p = p / "project_reasoner_v10_index.json"
    return p.resolve()


def next_available_output_json(base: Path) -> Path:
    if not base.exists():
        return base
    stem = base.stem
    parent = base.parent
    i = 1
    while True:
        candidate = parent / f"{stem}_{i:03d}.json"
        if not candidate.exists():
            return candidate
        i += 1

def _load_prefs() -> dict:
    try:
        if _PREFS_FILE.exists():
            return json.loads(_PREFS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:

    return {}


def _save_prefs(
    project_root: str,
    output_json: str,
    runtime_trace_json: str,
) -> None:
    try:
        _PREFS_FILE.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "project_root": project_root,
                    "output_json": output_json,
                    "runtime_trace_json": runtime_trace_json,
                },
                indent=2,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

_run_collector

def _run_collector(self) -> None:
    project_root = self.project_root_edit.text().strip()
    output_json_raw = self.output_json_edit.text().strip()
    runtime_trace_raw = self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text().strip()

    if not project_root:
        QMessageBox.warning(self, "Missing input", "Please set the project root.")
        return

    if not Path(project_root).is_dir():
        QMessageBox.warning(
            self,
            "Invalid path",
            f"Project root does not exist:\n{project_root}",
        )
        return

    output_json = resolve_output_json_path(output_json_raw)
    self._create_json_file_if_missing(output_json)
    self._current_output_json = str(output_json)

    _save_prefs(
        project_root,
        str(output_json),
        runtime_trace_raw,
    )

    self._append_log("Starting collector...")
    self._append_log(f"  root : {project_root}")
    self._append_log(f"  output: {output_json}")

    if has_active_runtime_scenario():
        log_runtime_event(
            "collector_run_started",
            payload={
                "project_root": project_root,
                "output_json": str(output_json),
            },
        )

    runtime_trace_json = None
    if runtime_trace_raw:
        runtime_trace_path = Path(runtime_trace_raw).expanduser()
        if runtime_trace_path.exists():
            runtime_trace_json = str(runtime_trace_path.resolve())

    if runtime_trace_json:
        self._append_log(f"  runtime_trace: {runtime_trace_json}")
    else:
        self._append_log(
            "  runtime_trace: not found - continuing without raw runtime trace merge"
        )

    self._process = QProcess(self)
    self._process.finished.connect(self._on_process_finished)
    self._process.errorOccurred.connect(self._on_process_error)

    process_args = [
        str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
        _CHILD_MODE_ARG,
        project_root,
        str(output_json),
        runtime_trace_json or "",
    ]

    self._start_busy_animation()
    self._process.start(sys.executable, process_args)

closeEvent

def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
    _save_prefs(
        self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
        self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
        self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text().strip(),
    )
    super().closeEvent(event)

before implementing  create a numered roadmap for that

  

    Freeze current runner behavior before adding automation
    Keep the current child-process collector flow unchanged as the baseline.
    Do not remove the existing manual Runtime Trace JSON field, prefs, animation, logs, or close behavior.
    Treat the new runtime generation as a pre-collector stage.

    Define the exact orchestration contract
    When the user clicks Run Collector, the runner will execute two stages in order:
    Stage A: generate a fresh runtime trace
    Stage B: run collector_main.run_collector(...) using that fresh trace
    If Stage A fails, the GUI must stop and report the runtime-trace failure instead of silently continuing with stale data.

    Use the GUI path as the single source of truth
    The file shown in Runtime Trace JSON becomes canonical for that run.
    The runtime generation stage must:
    create parent directories if needed
    write exactly to that path
    overwrite the previous file at that path
    never silently redirect to another default path

    Add a dedicated child-mode for runtime trace generation
    Extend reasoner_context_collector/runner.py with a second child command mode, parallel to --collector-child.
    Example concept:
    --runtime-trace-child
    This child mode will generate the runtime trace and exit with structured JSON on stdout, just like the collector child already does.

    Keep runtime generation outside the GUI thread
    Do not call runtime generation directly in the main GUI thread.
    Run it through QProcess, same as the collector stage, so the window stays responsive while:
    creating the trace
    overwriting the old file
    saving to disk

    Isolate runtime trace generation into one helper function
    Inside runner.py, add one helper dedicated to Stage A, for example:
    _run_runtime_trace_child(...)
    This function should be the only place that:
    configures the runtime writer
    triggers the target runtime scenario
    saves the trace
    returns success/failure payload

    Decide what actually exercises the project during Stage A
    This is the one architectural decision that must be explicit.
    There are two valid options:
    Option A: launch runtime_runner.py
    Option B: call runtime trace API directly inside the child process
    Because you asked for automatic generation from the data collector button, the cleaner canonical path is usually Option B inside the child process, unless your current runtime_runner.py already contains required scenario-driving logic that must be reused.

    Reuse the existing runtime API, not replace it
    Stage A should still rely on the same canonical runtime components:
    configure_runtime_trace(...)
    trace_event(...)
    trace_state_snapshot(...)
    save_runtime_trace()
    That preserves the existing runtime collector architecture while automating its use.

    Add an explicit scenario execution layer
    Generating an empty runtime trace is not enough.
    Stage A must run some actual scenario or exercise path between:
    configure_runtime_trace(...)
    and
    save_runtime_trace()
    So the roadmap needs a clear execution hook such as:
    call a known scenario function
    invoke a scenario runner module
    launch a controlled project entry path
    Without this, the file may be created but mostly empty.

    Make overwrite behavior explicit and deterministic

_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent.parent

_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON = (
    Path(__file__).parent / "project_reasoner_v10_index.json"
)

_DEFAULT_RUNTIME_TRACE_JSON = (
    _DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT
    / "developer_tools"
    / "kanda_reasoner_app"
    / "reasoner_runtime_collector"
    / "outputs"
    / "runtime_trace.json"
)

_PREFS_FILE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / ".collector_runner_prefs.json"

_CHILD_MODE_ARG = "--collector-child"
_RUNTIME_TRACE_CHILD_MODE_ARG = "--runtime-trace-child"


def _load_prefs() -> dict:
    try:
        if _PREFS_FILE.exists():
            return json.loads(_PREFS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return {}


def _save_prefs(
    project_root: str,
    output_json: str,
    runtime_trace_json: str,
) -> None:
    try:
        _PREFS_FILE.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "project_root": project_root,
                    "output_json": output_json,
                    "runtime_trace_json": runtime_trace_json,
                },
                indent=2,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
    except Exception:
        pass


def _run_runtime_trace_child(
    project_root: str,
    runtime_trace_json: str,
) -> int:
    try:
        trace_path = Path(runtime_trace_json).expanduser().resolve()
        trace_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        existed_before = trace_path.exists()
        if existed_before:
            try:
                trace_path.unlink()
            except Exception:
                pass

        configure_runtime_trace(
            project_root=project_root,
            output_path=str(trace_path),
            entry_script="",
        )

        trace_event(
            event_type="runtime_trace_generation_started",
            source_file="runner.py",
            source_symbol="_run_runtime_trace_child",
            message="Automatic runtime trace generation started from data collector runner.",
        )

        trace_state_snapshot(
            label="collector_runner_runtime_trace_context",
            state={
                "project_root": project_root,
                "runtime_trace_json": str(trace_path),
                "overwrote_existing_file": existed_before,
            },
        )

        trace_event(
            event_type="runtime_trace_generation_finished",
            source_file="runner.py",
            source_symbol="_run_runtime_trace_child",
            message="Automatic runtime trace generation finished.",
        )

        saved_path = save_runtime_trace()
        final_path = Path(saved_path).resolve() if saved_path is not None else trace_path

        payload = {
            "ok": True,
            "runtime_trace_json": str(final_path),
            "overwrote_existing": existed_before,
            "exists": final_path.exists(),
            "size": final_path.stat().st_size if final_path.exists() else 0,
        }
        print(json.dumps(payload), flush=True)
        return 0
    except Exception:
        print(traceback.format_exc(), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1


def _run_collector_child(
    project_root: str,
    output_json: str,
    runtime_trace_json: str | None,
) -> int:
    try:
        result = collector_main.run_collector(
            project_root=project_root,
            output_json=output_json,
            runtime_trace_json=runtime_trace_json,
        )
        payload = {
            "ok": True,
            "file_count": len(result.get("files", [])),
            "error_count": len(result.get("errors", [])),
            "output_json": output_json,
            "has_runtime_trace_summary": "runtime_trace_summary" in result,
            "has_runtime_scenario_summary": "runtime_scenario_summary" in result,
        }
        print(json.dumps(payload), flush=True)
        return 0
    except Exception:
        print(traceback.format_exc(), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1


def make_empty_index_payload() -> dict:
    return {"files": [], "errors": [], "project_summary": {}}


def resolve_output_json_path(raw: str) -> Path:
    p = Path(raw).expanduser()
    if not p.suffix.lower().endswith(".json"):
        p = p / "project_reasoner_v10_index.json"
    return p.resolve()


def next_available_output_json(base: Path) -> Path:
    if not base.exists():
        return base
    stem = base.stem
    parent = base.parent
    i = 1
    while True:
        candidate = parent / f"{stem}_{i:03d}.json"
        if not candidate.exists():
            return candidate
        i += 1

class CollectorRunnerWindow(QMainWindow):

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Project Reasoner v10 - Data Collector")
        self.resize(900, 600)

        self._prefs = _load_prefs()
        self._process: QProcess | None = None
        self._current_output_json: str = ""
        self._active_stage: str = ""
        self._pending_project_root: str = ""
        self._pending_output_json: str = ""
        self._pending_runtime_trace_json: str = ""

        self._busy_frames = ["-", "\\", "|", "/"]
        self._busy_index = 0

        self._busy_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._busy_timer.setInterval(120)
        self._busy_timer.timeout.connect(self._tick_busy_animation)

        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.browse_project_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_project_root)
        self.browse_output_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_output_json)
        self.browse_runtime_trace_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_runtime_trace_json)
        self.run_button.clicked.connect(self._run_collector)
        self.close_button.clicked.connect(self._close_application)

    def _browse_project_root(self) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self,
            "Select project root",
            self.project_root_edit.text(),
        )
        if folder:
            self.project_root_edit.setText(folder)
            _save_prefs(
                self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
                self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
                self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text().strip(),
            )

    def _browse_output_json(self) -> None:
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Select output JSON",
            self.output_json_edit.text(),
            "JSON files (*.json)",
        )
        if path:
            self.output_json_edit.setText(path)
            _save_prefs(
                self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
                self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
                self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text().strip(),
            )

    def _browse_runtime_trace_json(self) -> None:
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Select runtime trace JSON",
            self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text(),
            "JSON files (*.json)",
        )
        if path:
            self.runtime_trace_json_edit.setText(path)
            _save_prefs(
                self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
                self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
                self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text().strip(),
            )

    def _close_application(self) -> None:
        self.close()

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)
        scroll_bar = self.log_box.verticalScrollBar()
        scroll_bar.setValue(scroll_bar.maximum())

    def _create_json_file_if_missing(self, output_json: Path) -> None:
        if not output_json.exists():
            output_json.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            output_json.write_text(
                json.dumps(make_empty_index_payload(), indent=2),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            self._append_log(f"Created empty index file: {output_json}")

    def _start_busy_animation(self, stage_text: str) -> None:
        self._busy_index = 0
        self._active_stage = stage_text
        self.run_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.browse_project_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.browse_output_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.browse_runtime_trace_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(stage_text + "...")
        self._busy_timer.start()

    def _stop_busy_animation(self, status_text: str) -> None:
        self._busy_timer.stop()
        self.run_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.browse_project_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.browse_output_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.browse_runtime_trace_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.status_label.setText(status_text)
        self.setWindowTitle("Project Reasoner v10 - Data Collector")
        self._active_stage = ""

    def _tick_busy_animation(self) -> None:
        frame = self._busy_frames[self._busy_index % len(self._busy_frames)]
        self._busy_index += 1
        stage_text = self._active_stage or "Running"
        self.status_label.setText(f"{stage_text} {frame}")
        self.setWindowTitle(f"Project Reasoner v10 - Data Collector {frame}")

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        _save_prefs(
            self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
            self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
            self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text().strip(),
        )
        super().closeEvent(event)

Substitua _on_process_finished, _on_process_error, _run_collector e main() por estes.

    def _on_process_finished(self, exit_code: int, _exit_status) -> None:
        stdout_text = ""
        stderr_text = ""

        if self._process is not None:
            stdout_text = bytes(
                self._process.readAllStandardOutput()
            ).decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
            stderr_text = bytes(
                self._process.readAllStandardError()
            ).decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()

        if exit_code != 0:
            failed_stage = self._active_stage or "Process"
            self._stop_busy_animation("Failed")
            self._append_log(f"[ERROR] {failed_stage} failed:")
            self._append_log(stderr_text or stdout_text or "Unknown child-process error")

            if has_active_runtime_scenario():
                log_runtime_error(
                    "collector_run_failed",
                    payload={
                        "traceback": stderr_text or stdout_text or "Unknown child-process error",
                        "stage": failed_stage,
                    },
                )

            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Collector error",
                stderr_text or stdout_text or "Unknown child-process error",
            )
            self._process = None
            return

        try:
            result = json.loads(stdout_text) if stdout_text else {}
        except Exception:
            result = {}

        if self._active_stage == "Generating runtime trace":
            runtime_trace_path = str(result.get("runtime_trace_json", "") or "").strip()
            overwrote_existing = bool(result.get("overwrote_existing", False))
            trace_size = int(result.get("size", 0))

            if runtime_trace_path:
                self._pending_runtime_trace_json = runtime_trace_path
                self.runtime_trace_json_edit.setText(runtime_trace_path)

            self._append_log(
                f"[OK] Runtime trace generated - overwrote_existing={overwrote_existing}, size={trace_size}"
            )
            self._append_log(f"  runtime_trace: {self._pending_runtime_trace_json}")

            _save_prefs(
                self._pending_project_root,
                self._pending_output_json,
                self._pending_runtime_trace_json,
            )

            self._process = None
            self._start_collector_process()
            return

        file_count = int(result.get("file_count", 0))
        error_count = int(result.get("error_count", 0))

        self._stop_busy_animation("Finished")
        self._append_log(f"[OK] Done - {file_count} files indexed, {error_count} errors.")
        self._append_log(f"  Saved to: {self._current_output_json}")

        if has_active_runtime_scenario():
            log_runtime_event(
                "collector_run_finished",
                payload={
                    "file_count": file_count,
                    "error_count": error_count,
                    "output_json": self._current_output_json,
                },
            )

        self._process = None

    def _on_process_error(self, _process_error) -> None:
        failed_stage = self._active_stage or "Process"
        self._stop_busy_animation("Failed")
        self._append_log(f"[ERROR] {failed_stage} process could not start.")
        QMessageBox.critical(
            self,
            "Collector error",
            f"{failed_stage} process could not start.",
        )
        self._process = None

    def _run_collector(self) -> None:
        project_root = self.project_root_edit.text().strip()
        output_json_raw = self.output_json_edit.text().strip()
        runtime_trace_raw = self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text().strip()

        if not project_root:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Missing input", "Please set the project root.")
            return

        if not Path(project_root).is_dir():
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Invalid path",
                f"Project root does not exist:\n{project_root}",
            )
            return

        if not runtime_trace_raw:
            runtime_trace_raw = str(_DEFAULT_RUNTIME_TRACE_JSON.resolve())
            self.runtime_trace_json_edit.setText(runtime_trace_raw)

        output_json = resolve_output_json_path(output_json_raw)
        runtime_trace_path = Path(runtime_trace_raw).expanduser().resolve()

        self._create_json_file_if_missing(output_json)
        runtime_trace_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self._current_output_json = str(output_json)
        self._pending_project_root = project_root
        self._pending_output_json = str(output_json)
        self._pending_runtime_trace_json = str(runtime_trace_path)

        _save_prefs(
            self._pending_project_root,
            self._pending_output_json,
            self._pending_runtime_trace_json,
        )

        self._append_log("Starting runtime trace generation...")
        self._append_log(f"  root : {self._pending_project_root}")
        self._append_log(f"  output: {self._pending_output_json}")
        self._append_log(f"  runtime_trace: {self._pending_runtime_trace_json}")

        if has_active_runtime_scenario():
            log_runtime_event(
                "collector_run_started",
                payload={
                    "project_root": self._pending_project_root,
                    "output_json": self._pending_output_json,
                    "runtime_trace_json": self._pending_runtime_trace_json,
                },
            )

        self._start_runtime_trace_process()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Entry point
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main() -> None:
    if len(sys.argv) >= 4 and sys.argv[1] == _RUNTIME_TRACE_CHILD_MODE_ARG:
        project_root = sys.argv[2]
        runtime_trace_json = sys.argv[3]
        sys.exit(_run_runtime_trace_child(project_root, runtime_trace_json))

    if len(sys.argv) >= 4 and sys.argv[1] == _CHILD_MODE_ARG:
        project_root = sys.argv[2]
        output_json = sys.argv[3]
        runtime_trace_json = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) >= 5 and sys.argv[4] else None
        sys.exit(_run_collector_child(project_root, output_json, runtime_trace_json))

    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = CollectorRunnerWindow()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        print(traceback.format_exc(), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1


def _run_collector_child(
    project_root: str,
    output_json: str,
    runtime_trace_json: str | None,
) -> int:
    try:
        result = collector_main.run_collector(
            project_root=project_root,
            output_json=output_json,
            runtime_trace_json=runtime_trace_json,
        )
        payload = {
            "ok": True,
            "file_count": len(result.get("files", [])),
            "error_count": len(result.get("errors", [])),
            "output_json": output_json,
            "has_runtime_trace_summary": "runtime_trace_summary" in result,
            "has_runtime_scenario_summary": "runtime_scenario_summary" in result,
        }
        print(json.dumps(payload), flush=True)
        return 0
    except Exception:
        print(traceback.format_exc(), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1


def make_empty_index_payload() -> dict:
    return {"files": [], "errors": [], "project_summary": {}}


def resolve_output_json_path(raw: str) -> Path:
    p = Path(raw).expanduser()
    if not p.suffix.lower().endswith(".json"):
        p = p / "project_reasoner_v10_index.json"
    return p.resolve()


def next_available_output_json(base: Path) -> Path:
    if not base.exists():
        return base
    stem = base.stem
    parent = base.parent
    i = 1
    while True:
        candidate = parent / f"{stem}_{i:03d}.json"
        if not candidate.exists():
            return candidate
        i += 1


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main window
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class CollectorRunnerWindow(QMainWindow):

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Project Reasoner v10 - Data Collector")
        self.resize(900, 600)

        self._prefs = _load_prefs()
        self._process: QProcess | None = None
        self._current_output_json: str = ""
        self._active_stage: str = ""
        self._pending_project_root: str = ""
        self._pending_output_json: str = ""
        self._pending_runtime_trace_json: str = ""

        self._busy_frames = ["-", "\\", "|", "/"]
        self._busy_index = 0

        self._busy_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._busy_timer.setInterval(120)
        self._busy_timer.timeout.connect(self._tick_busy_animation)

        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # UI construction
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        central = QWidget()
        self.setCentralWidget(central)
        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(central)

        # Project root row
        root_row = QHBoxLayout()
        root_row.addWidget(QLabel("Project root:"))
        self.project_root_edit = QLineEdit(
            self._prefs.get("project_root", str(_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT))
        )
        root_row.addWidget(self.project_root_edit)
        self.browse_project_button = QPushButton("Browse...")
        root_row.addWidget(self.browse_project_button)
        main_layout.addLayout(root_row)

        # Output JSON row
        out_row = QHBoxLayout()
        out_row.addWidget(QLabel("Output JSON:"))
        self.output_json_edit = QLineEdit(
            self._prefs.get("output_json", str(_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON.resolve()))
        )
        out_row.addWidget(self.output_json_edit)
        self.browse_output_button = QPushButton("Browse...")
        out_row.addWidget(self.browse_output_button)
        main_layout.addLayout(out_row)

        # Runtime Trace JSON row
        trace_row = QHBoxLayout()
        trace_row.addWidget(QLabel("Runtime Trace JSON:"))
        self.runtime_trace_json_edit = QLineEdit(
            self._prefs.get(
                "runtime_trace_json",
                str(_DEFAULT_RUNTIME_TRACE_JSON.resolve()),
            )
        )
        trace_row.addWidget(self.runtime_trace_json_edit)
        self.browse_runtime_trace_button = QPushButton("Browse...")
        trace_row.addWidget(self.browse_runtime_trace_button)
        main_layout.addLayout(trace_row)

        # Button row
        button_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.run_button = QPushButton("Run Collector")
        self.close_button = QPushButton("Close")
        button_row.addWidget(self.run_button)
        button_row.addWidget(self.close_button)
        button_row.addStretch()
        main_layout.addLayout(button_row)

        self.status_label = QLabel("Idle")
        main_layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

        # Log area
        self.log_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.log_box.setReadOnly(True)
        main_layout.addWidget(self.log_box)

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.browse_project_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_project_root)
        self.browse_output_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_output_json)
        self.browse_runtime_trace_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_runtime_trace_json)
        self.run_button.clicked.connect(self._run_collector)
        self.close_button.clicked.connect(self._close_application)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)
        scroll_bar = self.log_box.verticalScrollBar()
        scroll_bar.setValue(scroll_bar.maximum())

    def _create_json_file_if_missing(self, output_json: Path) -> None:
        if not output_json.exists():
            output_json.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            output_json.write_text(
                json.dumps(make_empty_index_payload(), indent=2),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            self._append_log(f"Created empty index file: {output_json}")

    def _start_busy_animation(self, stage_text: str) -> None:
        self._busy_index = 0
        self._active_stage = stage_text
        self.run_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.browse_project_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.browse_output_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.browse_runtime_trace_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(stage_text + "...")
        self._busy_timer.start()

    def _stop_busy_animation(self, status_text: str) -> None:
        self._busy_timer.stop()
        self.run_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.browse_project_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.browse_output_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.browse_runtime_trace_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.status_label.setText(status_text)
        self.setWindowTitle("Project Reasoner v10 - Data Collector")
        self._active_stage = ""

    def _tick_busy_animation(self) -> None:
        frame = self._busy_frames[self._busy_index % len(self._busy_frames)]
        self._busy_index += 1
        stage_text = self._active_stage or "Running"
        self.status_label.setText(f"{stage_text} {frame}")
        self.setWindowTitle(f"Project Reasoner v10 - Data Collector {frame}")

    def _start_runtime_trace_process(self) -> None:
        self._process = QProcess(self)
        self._process.finished.connect(self._on_process_finished)
        self._process.errorOccurred.connect(self._on_process_error)

        process_args = [
            str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
            _RUNTIME_TRACE_CHILD_MODE_ARG,
            self._pending_project_root,
            self._pending_runtime_trace_json,
        ]

        self._start_busy_animation("Generating runtime trace")
        self._process.start(sys.executable, process_args)

    def _start_collector_process(self) -> None:
        self._process = QProcess(self)
        self._process.finished.connect(self._on_process_finished)
        self._process.errorOccurred.connect(self._on_process_error)

        process_args = [
            str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
            _CHILD_MODE_ARG,
            self._pending_project_root,
            self._pending_output_json,
            self._pending_runtime_trace_json,
        ]

        self._start_busy_animation("Running collector")
        self._process.start(sys.executable, process_args)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Slots
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _browse_project_root(self) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self,
            "Select project root",
            self.project_root_edit.text(),
        )
        if folder:
            self.project_root_edit.setText(folder)
            _save_prefs(
                self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
                self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
                self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text().strip(),
            )

    def _browse_output_json(self) -> None:
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Select output JSON",
            self.output_json_edit.text(),
            "JSON files (*.json)",
        )
        if path:
            self.output_json_edit.setText(path)
            _save_prefs(
                self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
                self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
                self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text().strip(),
            )

    def _browse_runtime_trace_json(self) -> None:
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Select runtime trace JSON",
            self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text(),
            "JSON files (*.json)",
        )
        if path:
            self.runtime_trace_json_edit.setText(path)
            _save_prefs(
                self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
                self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
                self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text().strip(),
            )

    def _close_application(self) -> None:
        self.close()

    def _on_process_finished(self, exit_code: int, _exit_status) -> None:
        stdout_text = ""
        stderr_text = ""

        if self._process is not None:
            stdout_text = bytes(
                self._process.readAllStandardOutput()
            ).decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
            stderr_text = bytes(
                self._process.readAllStandardError()
            ).decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()

        if exit_code != 0:
            failed_stage = self._active_stage or "Process"
            self._stop_busy_animation("Failed")
            self._append_log(f"[ERROR] {failed_stage} failed:")
            self._append_log(stderr_text or stdout_text or "Unknown child-process error")

            if has_active_runtime_scenario():
                log_runtime_error(
                    "collector_run_failed",
                    payload={
                        "traceback": stderr_text or stdout_text or "Unknown child-process error",
                        "stage": failed_stage,
                    },
                )

            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Collector error",
                stderr_text or stdout_text or "Unknown child-process error",
            )
            self._process = None
            return

        try:
            result = json.loads(stdout_text) if stdout_text else {}
        except Exception:
            result = {}

        if self._active_stage == "Generating runtime trace":
            runtime_trace_path = str(result.get("runtime_trace_json", "") or "").strip()
            overwrote_existing = bool(result.get("overwrote_existing", False))
            trace_size = int(result.get("size", 0))

            if runtime_trace_path:
                self._pending_runtime_trace_json = runtime_trace_path
                self.runtime_trace_json_edit.setText(runtime_trace_path)

            self._append_log(
                f"[OK] Runtime trace generated - overwrote_existing={overwrote_existing}, size={trace_size}"
            )
            self._append_log(f"  runtime_trace: {self._pending_runtime_trace_json}")

            _save_prefs(
                self._pending_project_root,
                self._pending_output_json,
                self._pending_runtime_trace_json,
            )

            self._process = None
            self._start_collector_process()
            return

        file_count = int(result.get("file_count", 0))
        error_count = int(result.get("error_count", 0))

        self._stop_busy_animation("Finished")
        self._append_log(f"[OK] Done - {file_count} files indexed, {error_count} errors.")
        self._append_log(f"  Saved to: {self._current_output_json}")

        if has_active_runtime_scenario():
            log_runtime_event(
                "collector_run_finished",
                payload={
                    "file_count": file_count,
                    "error_count": error_count,
                    "output_json": self._current_output_json,
                },
            )

        self._process = None

    def _on_process_error(self, _process_error) -> None:
        failed_stage = self._active_stage or "Process"
        self._stop_busy_animation("Failed")
        self._append_log(f"[ERROR] {failed_stage} process could not start.")
        QMessageBox.critical(
            self,
            "Collector error",
            f"{failed_stage} process could not start.",
        )
        self._process = None

    def _run_collector(self) -> None:
        project_root = self.project_root_edit.text().strip()
        output_json_raw = self.output_json_edit.text().strip()
        runtime_trace_raw = self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text().strip()

        if not project_root:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Missing input", "Please set the project root.")
            return

        if not Path(project_root).is_dir():
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Invalid path",
                f"Project root does not exist:\n{project_root}",
            )
            return

        if not runtime_trace_raw:
            runtime_trace_raw = str(_DEFAULT_RUNTIME_TRACE_JSON.resolve())
            self.runtime_trace_json_edit.setText(runtime_trace_raw)

        output_json = resolve_output_json_path(output_json_raw)
        runtime_trace_path = Path(runtime_trace_raw).expanduser().resolve()

        self._create_json_file_if_missing(output_json)
        runtime_trace_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self._current_output_json = str(output_json)
        self._pending_project_root = project_root
        self._pending_output_json = str(output_json)
        self._pending_runtime_trace_json = str(runtime_trace_path)

        _save_prefs(
            self._pending_project_root,
            self._pending_output_json,
            self._pending_runtime_trace_json,
        )

        self._append_log("Starting runtime trace generation...")
        self._append_log(f"  root : {self._pending_project_root}")
        self._append_log(f"  output: {self._pending_output_json}")
        self._append_log(f"  runtime_trace: {self._pending_runtime_trace_json}")

        if has_active_runtime_scenario():
            log_runtime_event(
                "collector_run_started",
                payload={
                    "project_root": self._pending_project_root,
                    "output_json": self._pending_output_json,
                    "runtime_trace_json": self._pending_runtime_trace_json,
                },
            )

        self._start_runtime_trace_process()

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        _save_prefs(
            self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
            self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
            self.runtime_trace_json_edit.text().strip(),
        )
        super().closeEvent(event)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Entry point
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main() -> None:
    if len(sys.argv) >= 4 and sys.argv[1] == _RUNTIME_TRACE_CHILD_MODE_ARG:
        project_root = sys.argv[2]
        runtime_trace_json = sys.argv[3]
        sys.exit(_run_runtime_trace_child(project_root, runtime_trace_json))

    if len(sys.argv) >= 4 and sys.argv[1] == _CHILD_MODE_ARG:
        project_root = sys.argv[2]
        output_json = sys.argv[3]
        runtime_trace_json = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) >= 5 and sys.argv[4] else None
        sys.exit(_run_collector_child(project_root, output_json, runtime_trace_json))

    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = CollectorRunnerWindow()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from developer_tools.kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_runtime_collector.runtime_trace_api import (
    configure_runtime_trace,
    save_runtime_trace,
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prefs - sidecar JSON sitting next to this runner.py
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_PREFS_FILE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / ".runtime_runner_prefs.json"

DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT = Path.cwd()
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON = (
    DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT
    / "developer_tools"
    / "kanda_reasoner_app"
    / "reasoner_runtime_collector"
    / "outputs"
    / "runtime_trace.json"
)


def _load_prefs() -> dict:
    try:
        if _PREFS_FILE.exists():
            return json.loads(_PREFS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return {}


def _save_prefs(project_root: str, output_json: str, entry_script: str = "") -> None:
    try:
        _PREFS_FILE.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "project_root": project_root,
                    "output_json": output_json,
                    "entry_script": entry_script,
                },
                indent=2,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
    except Exception:
        pass


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Background worker - flushes the trace to disk off the main thread
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _SaveWorker(QThread):
    """Calls save_runtime_trace in a background thread and emits results."""

    finished = Signal(str)
    errored = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, output_json: str, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._output_json = output_json

    def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            saved_path = save_runtime_trace()
            final_output_path = str(saved_path) if saved_path is not None else self._output_json
            self.finished.emit(final_output_path)
        except Exception:
            self.errored.emit(traceback.format_exc())


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Spinner
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_SPINNER_FRAMES = ["-", "\\", "|", "/"]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main window
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class RuntimeCollectorWindow(QMainWindow):
    """
    UI for the v10 runtime trace collector.

    Workflow
    --------
    1. Set project root, output JSON path, and optionally an entry script.
    2. Click "Configure Trace" -> calls configure_runtime_trace(); from this
       point any instrumented code running in-process will accumulate events
       in the in-memory RuntimeTraceWriter.
    3. Exercise the target code.
    4. Click "Save Trace" -> flushes the writer to disk as JSON.
    5. Click "Close" or the window close button -> saves prefs and exits.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Project Reasoner V10 Runtime Collector")
        self.resize(900, 520)

        prefs = _load_prefs()
        self.project_root_edit = QLineEdit(prefs.get("project_root", str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT)))
        self.output_json_edit = QLineEdit(prefs.get("output_json", str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON)))
        self.entry_script_edit = QLineEdit(prefs.get("entry_script", ""))

        self.browse_project_button = QPushButton("Browse Project")
        self.browse_output_button = QPushButton("Browse Output")
        self.browse_entry_button = QPushButton("Browse Entry")
        self.configure_button = QPushButton("Configure Trace")
        self.save_button = QPushButton("Save Trace")
        self.close_button = QPushButton("Close")

        self.save_button.setEnabled(False)

        self.log_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.log_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self._spinner_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._spinner_timer.setInterval(80)
        self._spinner_timer.timeout.connect(self._tick_spinner)
        self._spinner_frame = 0
        self._spinner_line = -1

        self._worker: _SaveWorker | None = None
        self._trace_configured = False

        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        central = QWidget()
        self.setCentralWidget(central)
        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(central)

        grid = QGridLayout()
        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Project root:"), 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.project_root_edit, 0, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.browse_project_button, 0, 2)

        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Output JSON:"), 1, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.output_json_edit, 1, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.browse_output_button, 1, 2)

        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Entry script:"), 2, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.entry_script_edit, 2, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.browse_entry_button, 2, 2)

        button_row = QHBoxLayout()
        button_row.addStretch()
        button_row.addWidget(self.configure_button)
        button_row.addWidget(self.save_button)
        button_row.addWidget(self.close_button)

        main_layout.addLayout(grid)
        main_layout.addLayout(button_row)
        main_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Log:"))
        main_layout.addWidget(self.log_box)

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.browse_project_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_project_root)
        self.browse_output_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_output_json)
        self.browse_entry_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_entry_script)
        self.configure_button.clicked.connect(self._configure_trace)
        self.save_button.clicked.connect(self._save_trace)
        self.close_button.clicked.connect(self.close)

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(str(text))

    def _start_spinner(self) -> None:
        self._append_log("")
        doc = self.log_box.document()
        self._spinner_line = doc.blockCount() - 1
        self._spinner_frame = 0
        self._spinner_timer.start()

    def _tick_spinner(self) -> None:
        frame = _SPINNER_FRAMES[self._spinner_frame % len(_SPINNER_FRAMES)]
        self._spinner_frame += 1
        self._update_spinner_line(f"{frame}  Saving trace...")

    def _update_spinner_line(self, text: str) -> None:
        doc = self.log_box.document()
        block = doc.findBlockByNumber(self._spinner_line)
        cursor = self.log_box.textCursor()
        cursor.setPosition(block.position())
        cursor.movePosition(cursor.MoveOperation.EndOfBlock, cursor.MoveMode.KeepAnchor)
        cursor.insertText(text)

    def _stop_spinner(self) -> None:
        self._spinner_timer.stop()
        if self._spinner_line >= 0:
            self._update_spinner_line("[OK] Trace saved.")
            self._spinner_line = -1

    def _browse_project_root(self) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self,
            "Select project root",
            self.project_root_edit.text().strip() or str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT),
        )
        if folder:
            self.project_root_edit.setText(folder)
            _save_prefs(
                folder,
                self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
                self.entry_script_edit.text().strip(),
            )

    def _browse_output_json(self) -> None:
        file_path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Select output JSON",
            self.output_json_edit.text().strip() or str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON),
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if file_path:
            self.output_json_edit.setText(file_path)
            _save_prefs(
                self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
                file_path,
                self.entry_script_edit.text().strip(),
            )

    def _browse_entry_script(self) -> None:
        file_path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select entry script",
            self.project_root_edit.text().strip() or str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT),
            "Python Files (*.py)",
        )
        if file_path:
            self.entry_script_edit.setText(file_path)
            _save_prefs(
                self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
                self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
                file_path,
            )

    def _configure_trace(self) -> None:
        project_root = self.project_root_edit.text().strip()
        output_json = self.output_json_edit.text().strip()
        entry_script = self.entry_script_edit.text().strip()

        if not output_json:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Missing output path", "Please specify an output JSON path.")
            return

        output_path = Path(output_json).expanduser()
        try:
            output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except Exception:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Cannot create output directory", traceback.format_exc())
            return

        try:
            configure_runtime_trace(
                project_root=project_root or str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT),
                output_path=str(output_path),
                entry_script=entry_script,
            )
        except Exception:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Configure failed", traceback.format_exc())
            self._append_log("Configure failed:")
            self._append_log(traceback.format_exc())
            return

        self._trace_configured = True
        self.save_button.setEnabled(True)

        self.log_box.clear()
        self._append_log("Trace configured.")
        self._append_log("Project root:  " + (project_root or "(not set)"))
        self._append_log("Output JSON:   " + str(output_path))
        self._append_log("Entry script:  " + (entry_script or "(not set)"))
        self._append_log("")
        self._append_log("Runtime trace writer is active.")
        self._append_log("Exercise the target code, then click 'Save Trace'.")

        _save_prefs(project_root, str(output_path), entry_script)

    def _save_trace(self) -> None:
        if not self._trace_configured:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Not configured",
                "Please click 'Configure Trace' before saving.",
            )
            return

        output_json = self.output_json_edit.text().strip()
        if not output_json:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Missing output path", "Please specify an output JSON path.")
            return

        self.configure_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.save_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._start_spinner()

        self._worker = _SaveWorker(output_json, parent=self)
        self._worker.finished.connect(self._on_save_finished)
        self._worker.errored.connect(self._on_save_error)
        self._worker.start()

    def _on_save_finished(self, output_path: str) -> None:
        self._stop_spinner()
        self.configure_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.save_button.setEnabled(True)

        self._append_log("")
        self._append_log("Trace saved: " + output_path)

        _save_prefs(
            self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
            output_path,
            self.entry_script_edit.text().strip(),
        )

        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Trace saved",
            "Runtime trace written to:\n" + output_path,
        )

    def _on_save_error(self, tb_str: str) -> None:
        self._stop_spinner()
        self.configure_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.save_button.setEnabled(True)

        QMessageBox.critical(self, "Save failed", tb_str)
        self._append_log("Save failed:")
        self._append_log(tb_str)

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        _save_prefs(
            self.project_root_edit.text().strip(),
            self.output_json_edit.text().strip(),
            self.entry_script_edit.text().strip(),
        )
        super().closeEvent(event)


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = RuntimeCollectorWindow()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Below is the complete updated runtime_runner.py.

It preserves the existing GUI/manual workflow and adds a headless automatic mode for the data-collector runner:
it accepts the runtime-trace path from environment
overwrites the old trace file at that exact path
runs an automatic scenario hook if provided
falls back to a richer synthetic scenario if no hook is configured
saves the fresh runtime_trace.json
prints a JSON payload to stdout for the parent runner

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import runpy
import sys
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from PySide6.QtCore import QThread, QTimer, Signal
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication,
    QFileDialog,
    QGridLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMainWindow,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from developer_tools.kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_runtime_collector.runtime_trace_api import (
    configure_runtime_trace,
    save_runtime_trace,
    trace_event,
    trace_state_snapshot,
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prefs - sidecar JSON sitting next to this runner.py
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_PREFS_FILE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / ".runtime_runner_prefs.json"

DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT = Path.cwd()
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON = (
    DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT
    / "developer_tools"
    / "kanda_reasoner_app"
    / "reasoner_runtime_collector"
    / "outputs"
    / "runtime_trace.json"
)

_ENV_PROJECT_ROOT = "PROJECT_REASONER_PROJECT_ROOT"
_ENV_RUNTIME_TRACE_JSON = "PROJECT_REASONER_RUNTIME_TRACE_JSON"
_ENV_RUNTIME_TRACE_OVERWRITE = "PROJECT_REASONER_RUNTIME_TRACE_OVERWRITE"
_ENV_ENTRY_SCRIPT = "PROJECT_REASONER_RUNTIME_ENTRY_SCRIPT"
_ENV_SCENARIO_MODULE = "PROJECT_REASONER_RUNTIME_SCENARIO_MODULE"
_ENV_EXECUTE_ENTRY_SCRIPT = "PROJECT_REASONER_RUNTIME_EXECUTE_ENTRY_SCRIPT"


def _load_prefs() -> dict:
    try:
        if _PREFS_FILE.exists():
            return json.loads(_PREFS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return {}


def _save_prefs(project_root: str, output_json: str, entry_script: str = "") -> None:
    try:
        _PREFS_FILE.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "project_root": project_root,
                    "output_json": output_json,
                    "entry_script": entry_script,
                },
                indent=2,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
    except Exception:
        pass


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Headless automatic mode
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _headless_mode_requested() -> bool:
    return bool(os.environ.get(_ENV_RUNTIME_TRACE_JSON, "").strip())


def _resolve_headless_config() -> dict:
    project_root_raw = os.environ.get(_ENV_PROJECT_ROOT, "").strip()
    output_json_raw = os.environ.get(_ENV_RUNTIME_TRACE_JSON, "").strip()
    overwrite_raw = os.environ.get(_ENV_RUNTIME_TRACE_OVERWRITE, "").strip()
    entry_script_raw = os.environ.get(_ENV_ENTRY_SCRIPT, "").strip()
    scenario_module_raw = os.environ.get(_ENV_SCENARIO_MODULE, "").strip()
    execute_entry_script_raw = os.environ.get(_ENV_EXECUTE_ENTRY_SCRIPT, "").strip()

    project_root = (
        Path(project_root_raw).expanduser().resolve()
        if project_root_raw
        else DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT.resolve()
    )

    output_json = (
        Path(output_json_raw).expanduser().resolve()
        if output_json_raw
        else DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON.resolve()
    )

    entry_script = (
        Path(entry_script_raw).expanduser().resolve()
        if entry_script_raw
        else None
    )

    return {
        "project_root": project_root,
        "output_json": output_json,
        "overwrite": overwrite_raw == "1",
        "entry_script": entry_script,
        "scenario_module": scenario_module_raw,
        "execute_entry_script": execute_entry_script_raw == "1",
    }


def _run_named_scenario_module(
    scenario_module: str,
    project_root: Path,
    entry_script: Path | None,
    output_json: Path,
) -> str:
    module = __import__(scenario_module, fromlist=["*"])

    candidate_names = [
        "collect_runtime_scenario",
        "run_runtime_scenario",
        "run",
        "main",
    ]

    for name in candidate_names:
        candidate = getattr(module, name, None)
        if not callable(candidate):
            continue

        try:
            candidate(
                project_root=str(project_root),
                entry_script=str(entry_script) if entry_script else "",
                output_json=str(output_json),
            )
            return name
        except TypeError:
            candidate()
            return name

    raise RuntimeError(
        "Scenario module does not expose a supported callable: "
        + scenario_module
    )


def _run_entry_script(entry_script: Path) -> None:
    runpy.run_path(str(entry_script), run_name="__main__")


def _run_rich_automatic_scenario(
    project_root: Path,
    output_json: Path,
    entry_script: Path | None,
    scenario_module: str,
    execute_entry_script: bool,
) -> str:
    trace_event(
        event_type="runtime_runner_automatic_scenario_started",
        source_file="runtime_runner.py",
        source_symbol="_run_rich_automatic_scenario",
        message="Automatic runtime scenario started.",
    )

    trace_state_snapshot(
        label="runtime_runner_automatic_scenario_context",
        state={
            "project_root": str(project_root),
            "output_json": str(output_json),
            "entry_script": str(entry_script) if entry_script else "",
            "entry_script_exists": bool(entry_script and entry_script.exists()),
            "scenario_module": scenario_module,
            "execute_entry_script": execute_entry_script,
        },
    )

    scenario_mode = "synthetic"

    if scenario_module:
        scenario_mode = "scenario_module"
        callable_name = _run_named_scenario_module(
            scenario_module=scenario_module,
            project_root=project_root,
            entry_script=entry_script,
            output_json=output_json,
        )
        trace_event(
            event_type="runtime_runner_scenario_module_executed",
            source_file="runtime_runner.py",
            source_symbol="_run_rich_automatic_scenario",
            message="Scenario module executed.",
            tags=["scenario_module", callable_name, scenario_module],
        )
    elif execute_entry_script and entry_script and entry_script.exists():
        scenario_mode = "entry_script"
        _run_entry_script(entry_script)
        trace_event(
            event_type="runtime_runner_entry_script_executed",
            source_file="runtime_runner.py",
            source_symbol="_run_rich_automatic_scenario",
            message="Entry script executed by runtime runner.",
            tags=["entry_script"],
        )
    else:
        trace_event(
            event_type="runtime_runner_synthetic_scenario_used",
            source_file="runtime_runner.py",
            source_symbol="_run_rich_automatic_scenario",
            message="No external scenario hook provided. Synthetic scenario recorded.",
            tags=["synthetic"],
        )

        trace_state_snapshot(
            label="runtime_runner_synthetic_project_state",
            state={
                "project_root_exists": project_root.exists(),
                "project_root_name": project_root.name,
                "output_parent_exists": output_json.parent.exists(),
                "output_parent": str(output_json.parent),
                "entry_script_provided": bool(entry_script),
                "entry_script_exists": bool(entry_script and entry_script.exists()),
            },
        )

    trace_event(
        event_type="runtime_runner_automatic_scenario_finished",
        source_file="runtime_runner.py",
        source_symbol="_run_rich_automatic_scenario",
        message="Automatic runtime scenario finished.",
        tags=[scenario_mode],
    )

    return scenario_mode


def _run_headless() -> int:
    try:
        config = _resolve_headless_config()

        project_root = config["project_root"]
        output_json = config["output_json"]
        overwrite = config["overwrite"]
        entry_script = config["entry_script"]
        scenario_module = config["scenario_module"]
        execute_entry_script = config["execute_entry_script"]

        output_json.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        existed_before = output_json.exists()
        if overwrite and existed_before:
            try:
                output_json.unlink()
            except Exception:
                pass

        configure_runtime_trace(
            project_root=str(project_root),
            output_path=str(output_json),
            entry_script=str(entry_script) if entry_script else "",
        )

        scenario_mode = _run_rich_automatic_scenario(
            project_root=project_root,
            output_json=output_json,
            entry_script=entry_script,
            scenario_module=scenario_module,
            execute_entry_script=execute_entry_script,
        )

        saved_path = save_runtime_trace()
        final_output_path = (
            Path(saved_path).expanduser().resolve()
            if saved_path is not None
            else output_json
        )

        payload = {
            "ok": True,
            "runtime_trace_json": str(final_output_path),
            "overwrote_existing": existed_before and overwrite,
            "exists": final_output_path.exists(),
            "size": final_output_path.stat().st_size if final_output_path.exists() else 0,
            "scenario_mode": scenario_mode,
        }
        print(json.dumps(payload), flush=True)
        return 0
    except Exception:
        print(traceback.format_exc(), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Background worker - flushes the trace to disk off the main thread
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _SaveWorker(QThread):
    """Calls save_runtime_trace in a background thread and emits results."""

    finished = Signal(str)
    errored = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, output_json: str, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._output_json = output_json

    def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            saved_path = save_runtime_trace()
            final_output_path = str(saved_path) if saved_path is not None else self._output_json
            self.finished.emit(final_output_path)
        except Exception:
            self.errored.emit(traceback.format_exc())

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_SPINNER_FRAMES = ["-", "\\", "|", "/"]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main window
