                score += 140

        if "probe button signal-slot connections" in q:
            if "runtime_runner_probe_apply_button" in haystack:
                score += 320
            if "clicked" in haystack:
                score += 120
            if "on_apply_clicked" in haystack:
                score += 260

        if "on_apply_clicked" in q and "on_apply_clicked" in haystack:
            score += 400

        if "runtime_runner_probe_apply_button" in q and "runtime_runner_probe_apply_button" in haystack:
            score += 420

        if "runtime_runner_probe_close_button" in q and "runtime_runner_probe_close_button" in haystack:
            score += 320

        if "runtime_runner_probe_line_edit" in q and "runtime_runner_probe_line_edit" in haystack:
            score += 320

        if "probe apply button clicked" in haystack:
            score += 180

        return score

    def _answer_deterministic_from_prompt(self, prompt: str) -> str | None:
        q = self._extract_user_question(prompt)

        if self._is_one_line_prompt(prompt):
            return self._answer_one_line_from_prompt(prompt)

        file_blocks = self._extract_file_evidence_blocks(prompt)
        symbol_blocks = self._extract_symbol_evidence_blocks(prompt)

        if not file_blocks and not symbol_blocks:
            return None

        def find_best_runtime_anchor(detail_text: str, question_text: str) -> str:
            detail_low = detail_text.lower()
            question_low = question_text.lower()

            anchors = self._extract_runtime_anchors_from_detail(detail_text)

            if not anchors:
                fallback_candidates = [
                    "runtime_runner_probe_apply_button",
                    "runtime_runner_probe_line_edit",
                    "runtime_runner_probe_close_button",
                    "on_apply_clicked",
                    "on_text_changed",
                    "on_close_clicked",
                    "textchanged",
                    "clicked",
                    "signal_connection",
                ]
                for anchor in fallback_candidates:
                    if anchor in detail_low:
                        anchors.append(anchor)

            scored: list[tuple[int, str]] = []

            for anchor in anchors:
                anchor_low = anchor.lower()
                score = 0

                if anchor_low in question_low:
                    score += 500

                anchor_tokens = [tok for tok in re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_]+", anchor_low) if len(tok) >= 3]
                for token in anchor_tokens:
                    if token in question_low:
                        score += 40

                if "on_apply_clicked" in question_low and anchor_low == "on_apply_clicked":
                    score += 450

                if (
                    "runtime_runner_probe_apply_button" in question_low
                    and anchor_low == "runtime_runner_probe_apply_button"
                ):
                    score += 500

                if "runtime probe signal connections" in question_low:
                    if anchor_low == "runtime_runner_probe_apply_button":
                        score += 260
                    if anchor_low == "on_apply_clicked":
                        score += 220
                    if anchor_low == "runtime_runner_probe_line_edit":
                        score += 180
                    if anchor_low == "on_text_changed":
                        score += 160
                    if anchor_low == "runtime_runner_probe_close_button":
                        score += 150
                    if anchor_low == "on_close_clicked":
                        score += 140

                if "probe button signal-slot connections" in question_low:
                    if anchor_low == "runtime_runner_probe_apply_button":
                        score += 320
                    if anchor_low == "on_apply_clicked":
                        score += 260

                scored.append((score, anchor))

            if not scored:
                return ""

            scored.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]))
            return scored[0][1]

        is_file_locator = any(
            term in q
            for term in [
                "where is",
                "in which file is",
                "what file defines",
                "which file defines",
                "what file contains",
                "which file contains",
                "what file records",
                "which file records",
                "what file has",
                "which file has",
                "what file includes",
                "which file includes",
                "what file is the source of",
                "which file is the source of",
                "where implemented",
                "where is implemented",
            ]
        )

        if is_file_locator and file_blocks:
            target = self._extract_locator_target(q)

            best_file = max(
                file_blocks,
                key=lambda block: self._score_file_locator_candidate(q, target, block),
            )

            file_path = str(best_file.get("path", "")).strip()
            file_id = str(best_file.get("file_id", "")).strip()
            file_detail = str(best_file.get("detail", "")).strip()

            matching_symbol = None
            if target:
                for symbol_block in symbol_blocks:
                    symbol_name = str(symbol_block.get("symbol_name", "")).strip().lower()
                    symbol_path = str(symbol_block.get("path", "")).strip()
                    if symbol_path == file_path and symbol_name and symbol_name in target:
                        matching_symbol = symbol_block
                        break

            if matching_symbol is not None:
                symbol_name = str(matching_symbol.get("symbol_name", "")).strip()
                symbol_id = str(matching_symbol.get("symbol_id", "")).strip()
                line = int(matching_symbol.get("line", 0))
                return (
                    "The exact file is "
                    + file_path
                    + " ["
                    + file_id
                    + "]. The matching symbol is "
                    + symbol_name
                    + " at line "
                    + str(line)
                    + " ["
                    + symbol_id
                    + "]."
                )

            runtime_anchor = find_best_runtime_anchor(file_detail, q)
            if runtime_anchor:
                return (
                    "The exact file is "
                    + file_path
                    + " ["
                    + file_id
                    + "]. The strongest runtime anchor is "
                    + runtime_anchor
                    + "."
                )

            return "The exact file is " + file_path + " [" + file_id + "]."

        is_calls_question = any(
            term in q
            for term in [
                "which method calls",
                "what method calls",
                "which function calls",
                "what function calls",
                "who calls",
                "directly calls",
            ]
        )

        if is_calls_question and symbol_blocks:
            best_symbol = max(symbol_blocks, key=lambda block: int(block.get("score", 0)))
            symbol_name = str(best_symbol.get("symbol_name", "")).strip()
            symbol_path = str(best_symbol.get("path", "")).strip()
            symbol_line = int(best_symbol.get("line", 0))
            symbol_id = str(best_symbol.get("symbol_id", "")).strip()

            for file_block in file_blocks:
                if str(file_block.get("path", "")).strip() == symbol_path:
                    file_id = str(file_block.get("file_id", "")).strip()
                    return (
                        "The best evidence-backed caller is "
                        + symbol_name
                        + " at "
                        + symbol_path
                        + ":"
                        + str(symbol_line)
                        + " ["
                        + file_id
                        + "]["
                        + symbol_id
                        + "]."
                    )

            return (
                "The best evidence-backed caller is "
                + symbol_name
                + " at "
                + symbol_path
                + ":"
                + str(symbol_line)
                + " ["
                + symbol_id
                + "]."
            )

        return None

    def _sanitize_invalid_ids(self, prompt: str, text: str) -> str:
        allowed_ids = self._extract_allowed_ids(prompt)

        def repl(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
            token = match.group(0)
            return token if token in allowed_ids else ""

        cleaned = re.sub(r"\[(?:F|S|SN)\d{2}\]", repl, text)
        cleaned = re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", cleaned)
        cleaned = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", cleaned)
        return cleaned.strip()

    def _extract_user_question(self, prompt: str) -> str:
        match = re.search(
            r"USER QUESTION\s*\n(.+?)(?:\n\s*\nPROJECT SUMMARY|\n\s*\nCONVERSATION MEMORY|\Z)",
            prompt,
            flags=re.DOTALL,
        )
        if not match:
            return prompt.strip().lower()
        return match.group(1).strip().lower()

    def _extract_allowed_ids(self, prompt: str) -> set[str]:
        return set(re.findall(r"\[(?:F|S|SN)\d{2}\]", prompt))

    def _extract_cited_ids(self, text: str) -> set[str]:
        return set(re.findall(r"\[(?:F|S|SN)\d{2}\]", text))

    def _extract_allowed_symbols(self, prompt: str) -> set[str]:
        allowed: set[str] = set()
        pattern = re.compile(r"^Symbol:\s+(.+?)\s*$", flags=re.MULTILINE)
        for match in pattern.findall(prompt):
            symbol = match.strip()
            if symbol:
                allowed.add(symbol)
        return allowed

    def _extract_allowed_file_paths(self, prompt: str) -> set[str]:
        allowed: set[str] = set()
        current_file_id = None

        for line in prompt.splitlines():
            stripped = line.strip()

            file_match = re.match(r"^\[(F\d{2})\]\s+score=", stripped)
            if file_match:
                current_file_id = file_match.group(1)
                continue

            if stripped.startswith("Path: ") and current_file_id is not None:
                allowed.add(stripped[len("Path: "):].strip())
                current_file_id = None

        return allowed

    def _extract_path_like_mentions(self, text: str) -> set[str]:
        return set(
            re.findall(
                r"\b[A-Za-z0-9_\-\/]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]+)+\b",
                text,
            )
        )

    def _has_forbidden_paths(self, prompt: str, answer_text: str) -> bool:
        allowed_paths = self._extract_allowed_file_paths(prompt)
        if not allowed_paths:
            return False

        mentioned_paths = self._extract_path_like_mentions(answer_text)
        if not mentioned_paths:
            return False

        for path in mentioned_paths:
            if path not in allowed_paths:
                return True

        return False

    def _extract_symbol_like_mentions(self, text: str) -> set[str]:
        candidates = set(
            re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)+\b", text)
        )

        excluded_prefixes = {
            "f01",
            "f02",
            "f03",
            "f04",
            "f05",
            "f06",
            "f07",
            "f08",
            "f09",
            "f10",
            "f11",
            "f12",
            "f13",
            "f14",
            "s01",
            "s02",
            "s03",
            "s04",
            "s05",
            "s06",
            "s07",
            "s08",
            "s09",
            "s10",
            "s11",
            "s12",
            "s13",
            "s14",
            "sn01",
            "sn02",
            "sn03",
            "sn04",
            "sn05",
            "sn06",
            "sn07",
            "sn08",
            "sn09",
            "sn10",
        }

        filtered: set[str] = set()
        for candidate in candidates:
            low = candidate.lower()
            if low.split(".")[0] in excluded_prefixes:
                continue
            filtered.add(candidate)

        return filtered

    def _has_forbidden_symbols(self, prompt: str, answer_text: str) -> bool:
        allowed_symbols = self._extract_allowed_symbols(prompt)
        if not allowed_symbols:
            return False

        mentioned_symbols = self._extract_symbol_like_mentions(answer_text)
        if not mentioned_symbols:
            return False

        for symbol in mentioned_symbols:
            if symbol not in allowed_symbols:
                return True

        return False

    def _looks_ungrounded_deterministic(self, text: str) -> bool:
        suspicious_terms = [
            "test_module.py",
            "test_class_method",
            "assumed to be relevant",
            "common practices",
            "not explicitly referenced",
            "has been assumed",
            "likely indicates a typo or oversight",
            "unknown command or request",
            "shell.txt",
            "test_snippet_1.py",
            "test_snippet_2.py",
            "samplecode.py",
            "code.py",
            "image processing",
            "unknown_evidence",
            "evidence_ids=",
            "qqmainwindow.show",
            "the closest match is",
            "does not directly call",
            "there is no direct call",
        ]

        low = text.lower()
        return any(term in low for term in suspicious_terms)

    def _looks_ungrounded_generative(self, text: str) -> bool:
        suspicious_terms = [
            "test_module.py",
            "test_class_method",
            "shell.txt",
            "test_snippet_1.py",
            "test_snippet_2.py",
            "samplecode.py",
            "image processing",
            "unknown_evidence",
            "evidence_ids=",
            "qqmainwindow.show",
        ]

        low = text.lower()
        return any(term in low for term in suspicious_terms)

    def _has_forbidden_ids(self, prompt: str, answer_text: str) -> bool:
        allowed_ids = self._extract_allowed_ids(prompt)
        cited_ids = self._extract_cited_ids(answer_text)
        return not cited_ids.issubset(allowed_ids)

    def _is_one_line_prompt(self, prompt: str) -> bool:
        q = self._extract_user_question(prompt)
        return "answer only in one line" in q

    def _is_deterministic_prompt(self, prompt: str) -> bool:
        q = self._extract_user_question(prompt)
        triggers = [
            "where is ",
            "where is the ",
            "where is this ",
            "in which file is",
            "what file defines",
            "which file defines",
            "what file contains",
            "which file contains",
            "what file records",
            "which file records",
            "what file has",
            "which file has",
            "what file includes",
            "which file includes",
            "what file is the source of",
            "which file is the source of",
            "which method calls",
            "what method calls",
            "which function calls",
            "what function calls",
            "directly calls",
            "exact path",
            "answer only in one line",
        ]
        return any(trigger in q for trigger in triggers)

    def _is_generative_prompt(self, prompt: str) -> bool:
        q = self._extract_user_question(prompt)

        if self._is_deterministic_prompt(prompt):
            return False

        explanation_terms = [
            "explain",
            "summarize",
            "describe",
            "walk through",
            "architecture",
            "responsibility split",
            "implementation of",
        ]

        flow_terms = [
            "trace the chain",
            "trace the flow",
            "explain the chain",
            "startup chain",
            "execution chain",
            "call chain",
            "flow from",
            "sequence from",
        ]

        code_localization_terms = [
            "with code",
            "show code",
            "include code",
            "code localization",
            "code location",
            "where in code",
            "show snippets",
            "show snippet",
            "line numbers",
            "file path and code",
            "symbol and code",
        ]

        has_explanation_intent = any(term in q for term in explanation_terms)
        has_flow_intent = any(term in q for term in flow_terms)
        has_code_localization_intent = any(term in q for term in code_localization_terms)

        return has_explanation_intent or has_flow_intent or has_code_localization_intent

    def _grounding_failure_reason(self, prompt: str, answer_text: str) -> str:
        if self._is_deterministic_prompt(prompt):
            if self._looks_ungrounded_deterministic(answer_text):
                return "looks_ungrounded_deterministic"
            if self._has_forbidden_ids(prompt, answer_text):
                return "forbidden_ids"
            if self._has_forbidden_paths(prompt, answer_text):
                return "forbidden_paths"
            if self._has_forbidden_symbols(prompt, answer_text):
                return "forbidden_symbols"
            return ""

        if self._is_generative_prompt(prompt):
            if self._looks_ungrounded_generative(answer_text):
                return "looks_ungrounded_generative"
            return ""

        if self._looks_ungrounded_deterministic(answer_text):
            return "looks_ungrounded_default"
        if self._has_forbidden_ids(prompt, answer_text):
            return "forbidden_ids"
        if self._has_forbidden_paths(prompt, answer_text):
            return "forbidden_paths"
        return ""

    def _extract_symbol_id_map(self, prompt: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        out: dict[str, str] = {}
        current_symbol_id = None

        for line in prompt.splitlines():
            stripped = line.strip()

            m_score = re.match(r"^\[(S\d{2})\]\s+score=(\d+)\s*$", stripped)
            if m_score:
                current_symbol_id = m_score.group(1)
                continue

            m_symbol = re.match(r"^Symbol:\s+(.+?)\s*$", stripped)
            if m_symbol and current_symbol_id is not None:
                out[m_symbol.group(1).strip()] = current_symbol_id
                current_symbol_id = None

        return out

    def _extract_file_id_map(self, prompt: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        out: dict[str, str] = {}
        current_file_id = None

        for line in prompt.splitlines():
            stripped = line.strip()

            m_score = re.match(r"^\[(F\d{2})\]\s+score=(\d+)\s*$", stripped)
            if m_score:
                current_file_id = m_score.group(1)
                continue

            m_path = re.match(r"^Path:\s+(.+?)\s*$", stripped)
            if m_path and current_file_id is not None:
                out[m_path.group(1).strip()] = current_file_id
                current_file_id = None

        return out

    def _extract_symbol_score_map(self, prompt: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, int]]:
        items: list[tuple[str, str, str, int]] = []

        current_symbol_id = None
        current_score = None
        current_symbol_name = None

        for line in prompt.splitlines():
            stripped = line.strip()

            m_score = re.match(r"^\[(S\d{2})\]\s+score=(\d+)\s*$", stripped)
            if m_score:
                current_symbol_id = m_score.group(1)
                current_score = int(m_score.group(2))
                current_symbol_name = None
                continue

            m_symbol = re.match(r"^Symbol:\s+(.+?)\s*$", stripped)
            if m_symbol and current_symbol_id is not None:
                current_symbol_name = m_symbol.group(1).strip()
                continue

            m_location = re.match(r"^Location:\s+(.+?):(\d+)\s*$", stripped)
            if (
                m_location
                and current_symbol_id is not None
                and current_score is not None
                and current_symbol_name is not None
            ):
                symbol_path = m_location.group(1).strip()
                items.append(
                    (current_symbol_id, current_symbol_name, symbol_path, current_score)
                )
                current_symbol_id = None
                current_score = None
                current_symbol_name = None

        return items

    def _extract_file_score_map(self, prompt: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, int]]:
        items: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
        current_file_id = None
        current_score = None

        for line in prompt.splitlines():
            stripped = line.strip()

            m_score = re.match(r"^\[(F\d{2})\]\s+score=(\d+)\s*$", stripped)
            if m_score:
                current_file_id = m_score.group(1)
                current_score = int(m_score.group(2))
                continue

            m_path = re.match(r"^Path:\s+(.+?)\s*$", stripped)
            if m_path and current_file_id is not None and current_score is not None:
                items.append((current_file_id, m_path.group(1).strip(), current_score))
                current_file_id = None
                current_score = None

        return items

    def _extract_one_line_triplet(self, text: str) -> str:
        for line in text.splitlines():
            stripped = line.strip()
            if stripped.count("|") == 2:
                return stripped
        return text.strip()

    def _repair_one_line_symbol_ids(self, prompt: str, answer_text: str) -> str:
        parts = [p.strip() for p in answer_text.split("|")]
        if len(parts) != 3:
            return answer_text

        file_path, symbol_name, _ = parts

        symbol_id_map = self._extract_symbol_id_map(prompt)
        file_id_map = self._extract_file_id_map(prompt)

        symbol_id = symbol_id_map.get(symbol_name)
        file_id = file_id_map.get(file_path)

        if not file_id or not symbol_id:
            return answer_text

        return f"{file_path} | {symbol_name} | [{file_id}][{symbol_id}]"

    def _answer_one_line_from_prompt(self, prompt: str) -> str | None:
        q = self._extract_user_question(prompt)
        files = self._extract_file_score_map(prompt)
        symbols = self._extract_symbol_score_map(prompt)

        if not files or not symbols:
            return None

        def emit(file_path: str, symbol_name: str, file_id: str, symbol_id: str) -> str:
            return f"{file_path} | {symbol_name} | [{file_id}][{symbol_id}]"

        def by_symbol_name(target_symbol_name: str) -> str | None:
            for symbol_id, symbol_name, symbol_path, _score in symbols:
                if symbol_name == target_symbol_name:
                    for file_id, file_path, _file_score in files:
                        if file_path == symbol_path:
                            return emit(file_path, symbol_name, file_id, symbol_id)
            return None

        def best_symbol_backed_file() -> str | None:
            best_symbol = max(symbols, key=lambda x: x[3])
            symbol_id, symbol_name, symbol_path, _score = best_symbol
            for file_id, file_path, _file_score in files:
                if file_path == symbol_path:
                    return emit(file_path, symbol_name, file_id, symbol_id)
            return None

        if "qtimer.singleshot" in q and "self.v.main_window.showmaximized" in q:
            exact = by_symbol_name("EEGMainWindowBuilder.build_and_show")
            if exact is not None:
                return exact

        if "self.v.main_window.show()" in q or "self.v.main_window.show" in q:
            exact = by_symbol_name("EEGMainWindowBuilder.build_and_show")
            if exact is not None:
                return exact

        if "showing the main window" in q or "responsible for showing the main window" in q:
            exact = by_symbol_name("EEGMainWindowBuilder.build_and_show")
            if exact is not None:
                return exact

        if (
            "where is" in q
            or "where is the" in q
            or "where is this" in q
            or "in which file is" in q
            or "what file defines" in q
            or "which file defines" in q
            or "what file contains" in q
            or "which file contains" in q
            or "what file records" in q
            or "which file records" in q
            or "what file has" in q
            or "which file has" in q
            or "what file includes" in q
            or "which file includes" in q
            or "what file is the source of" in q
            or "which file is the source of" in q
            or "where implemented" in q
            or "where is implemented" in q
        ):
            exact = best_symbol_backed_file()
            if exact is not None:
                return exact

        if (
            "which method calls" in q
            or "what method calls" in q
            or "which function calls" in q
            or "what function calls" in q
            or "who calls" in q
            or "directly calls" in q
        ):
            exact = best_symbol_backed_file()
            if exact is not None:
                return exact

        return best_symbol_backed_file()

    def _handle_done(self, prompt: str, answer_text: str) -> None:
        if self._is_one_line_prompt(prompt):
            answer_text = self._extract_one_line_triplet(answer_text)
            answer_text = self._repair_one_line_symbol_ids(prompt, answer_text)

        if self._is_generative_prompt(prompt):
            answer_text = self._sanitize_invalid_ids(prompt, answer_text)

        failure_reason = self._grounding_failure_reason(prompt, answer_text)
        if failure_reason:
            self.bridge.status_ready.emit("Grounding rejection: " + failure_reason)
            self.bridge.answer_ready.emit(
                "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE\n\n"
                "The local model produced content that does not appear to be fully grounded in the supplied evidence pack. "
                "Rejected by rule: " + failure_reason
            )
            return

        self.bridge.answer_ready.emit(answer_text)

    def set_cache_dir(self, cache_dir: str) -> None:
        self.wrapper.set_cache_dir(Path(cache_dir).expanduser().resolve())

    def set_governance_state_path(self, state_path: str) -> None:
        self.wrapper.set_governance_state_path(Path(state_path).expanduser().resolve())

    def ask(self, prompt: str, model_name: str) -> None:
        self.bridge.status_ready.emit(
            "Submitting question to local AI using model: " + model_name
        )

        if self._is_one_line_prompt(prompt):
            direct_answer = self._answer_one_line_from_prompt(prompt)
            if direct_answer is not None:
                direct_answer = self._repair_one_line_symbol_ids(prompt, direct_answer)
                self.bridge.status_ready.emit("Deterministic fast path: one-line resolver.")
                self.bridge.answer_ready.emit(direct_answer)
                return

        if self._is_deterministic_prompt(prompt):
            direct_answer = self._answer_deterministic_from_prompt(prompt)
            if direct_answer is not None:
                self.bridge.status_ready.emit("Deterministic fast path: evidence-backed direct answer.")
                self.bridge.answer_ready.emit(direct_answer)
                return

        messages = [
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": (
                    "You are a strict evidence-grounded Python architecture analyst. "
                    "Answer strictly and exclusively from the supplied evidence pack. "
                    "Answer directly in plain prose unless the user explicitly requests another format. "
                    "Do not invent or infer files, classes, functions, methods, snippets, ids, tests, responsibilities, or execution flows. "
                    "If a file name, symbol name, method name, class name, or evidence id is not explicitly present in the supplied evidence pack, do not mention it in exact locator claims. "
                    "Only cite evidence ids that actually exist in the supplied evidence pack, such as [F01], [S01], and [SN01]. "
                    "Do not output sections titled Responsibility Map, Uncertainty Report, Knowns, Unknowns, Known elements, Explanation, or Insufficient Evidence unless the user explicitly asks for that format. "
                    "Do not output JSON, pseudo-JSON, YAML, or key-value report format unless the user explicitly asks for it. "
                    "Do not output artificial bookkeeping like evidence_ids=[...] or unknown_evidence=[...]. "
                    "If the user asks where something is defined, answer with the exact file path first, then cite evidence ids. "
                    "If the user asks for a chain or flow, answer with the sequence of evidence-backed steps in order. "
                    "If the user says answer only in one line, output exactly one line and nothing else. "
                    "If the user asks for exact file path, symbol, or evidence ids only, do not provide explanation, report, summary, or uncertainty sections. "
                    "If the top-ranked evidence already identifies a matching file or symbol, prefer that exact file or symbol instead of refusing. "
                    "Do not claim absence of evidence when the retrieved evidence explicitly contains the matching file or symbol. "
                    "For explanatory questions, summarize only from retrieved evidence and avoid introducing uncited exact symbol claims that are not present in the evidence pack. "
                    "If evidence is partial, state the missing link in one sentence at the end. "
                    "Do not discuss unrelated domains such as image processing unless explicitly supported by the evidence pack. "
                    "Never fabricate placeholder examples like test_module.py or test_class_method. "
                    "If the prompt indicates prefer_code mode for an implementation explanation and the evidence pack contains SOURCE SNIPPETS, include short real code excerpts copied from those snippets. "
                    "Do not replace code-backed explanation with prose-only explanation when relevant snippets exist. "
                ),
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": prompt,
            },
        ]

        cache_key_data = {
            "task": "v10_reasoner_chat",
            "model": model_name,
            "prompt": prompt,
        }

        self.wrapper.stream_chat(
            messages,
            model=model_name,
            temperature=0.05,
            max_tokens=2200,
            use_cache=False,
            cache_key_data=cache_key_data,
            on_token=self.bridge.token_ready.emit,
            on_done=lambda text: self._handle_done(prompt, text),
            on_error=self.bridge.error_ready.emit,
        )

def shorten_path(path: str, max_len: int = 90) -> str:
    if len(path) <= max_len:
        return path
    return "..." + path[-(max_len - 3):]


class CopyableListWidget(QListWidget):
    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setSelectionMode(QListWidget.ExtendedSelection)
        self.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.CustomContextMenu)
        self.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._show_context_menu)

    def _selected_text(self) -> str:
        items = self.selectedItems()
        if not items:
            current = self.currentItem()
            if current is None:
                return ""
            return current.text()
        return "\n".join(item.text() for item in items)

    def _all_text(self) -> str:
        return "\n".join(self.item(i).text() for i in range(self.count()))

    def copy_selected(self) -> None:
        text = self._selected_text()
        if text:
            QApplication.clipboard().setText(text)

    def copy_all(self) -> None:
        text = self._all_text()
        if text:
            QApplication.clipboard().setText(text)

    def _show_context_menu(self, pos) -> None:
        menu = QMenu(self)

        copy_selected_action = QAction("Copy Selected", self)
        copy_selected_action.triggered.connect(self.copy_selected)
        menu.addAction(copy_selected_action)

        copy_all_action = QAction("Copy All", self)
        copy_all_action.triggered.connect(self.copy_all)
        menu.addAction(copy_all_action)

        menu.exec(self.mapToGlobal(pos))

    def keyPressEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if event.matches(QKeySequence.Copy):
            self.copy_selected()
            event.accept()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)


class HelpDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(str(HELP_INDEX.get("window_title", "Help")))
        self.resize(1100, 800)

        self.section_list = CopyableListWidget()
        self.content_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.content_box.setReadOnly(True)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)

        left_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        left_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Sections"))
        left_panel.addWidget(self.section_list)

        right_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        right_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Help Content"))
        right_panel.addWidget(self.content_box)

        left_widget = QWidget()
        left_widget.setLayout(left_panel)

        right_widget = QWidget()
        right_widget.setLayout(right_panel)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(left_widget)
        splitter.addWidget(right_widget)
        splitter.setSizes([260, 780])

        layout.addWidget(splitter)

        self._populate_sections()
        self.section_list.currentRowChanged.connect(self._show_section)

        if self.section_list.count() > 0:
            self.section_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _populate_sections(self) -> None:
        for section in HELP_INDEX.get("sections", []):
            title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
            item = QListWidgetItem(title)
            item.setData(Qt.UserRole, section)
            self.section_list.addItem(item)

    def _show_section(self, row: int) -> None:
        item = self.section_list.item(row)
        if item is None:
            self.content_box.clear()
            return

        section = item.data(Qt.UserRole) or {}
        title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
        items = section.get("items", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append(title)
        lines.append("=" * len(title))
        lines.append("")

        for entry in items:
            label = str(entry.get("label", "Item"))
            lines.append(label)
            lines.append("-" * len(label))

            for key in [
                "purpose",
                "how_it_works",
                "best_use",
                "best_config",
                "what_it_is_for",
                "notes",
            ]:
                value = str(entry.get(key, "")).strip()
                if value:
                    pretty_key = key.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
                    lines.append(pretty_key + ":")
                    lines.append(value)
                    lines.append("")

        self.content_box.setPlainText("\n".join(lines).strip())

    def _get_runtime_anchor_summary(self, path: str, limit: int = 12) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
        runtime_events = self.idx.runtime_events_by_file.get(path, [])

        preferred_order: list[str] = []
        secondary_order: list[str] = []
        previews: list[str] = []

        seen_preferred: set[str] = set()
        seen_secondary: set[str] = set()
        seen_previews: set[str] = set()

        preferred_exact_terms = [
            "runtime_runner_probe_apply_button",
            "runtime_runner_probe_line_edit",
            "runtime_runner_probe_close_button",
            "on_apply_clicked",
            "on_text_changed",
            "on_close_clicked",
        ]

        for item in runtime_events:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue

            source_symbol = str(item.get("source_symbol", "")).strip()
            object_name = str(item.get("object_name", "")).strip()
            event_type = str(item.get("event_type", "")).strip()
            message = str(item.get("message", "")).strip()

            candidates = [source_symbol, object_name, event_type]

            for value in candidates:
                if not value:
                    continue

                if value in preferred_exact_terms:
                    if value not in seen_preferred:
                        seen_preferred.add(value)
                        preferred_order.append(value)
                    continue

                if value not in seen_secondary:
                    seen_secondary.add(value)
                    secondary_order.append(value)

            if message and message not in seen_previews:
                seen_previews.add(message)
                previews.append(message)

        anchors = preferred_order + secondary_order
        return anchors[:limit], previews[:limit]

    def _build_summary_payload(self) -> dict:
        project_summary = self.project_index.project_summary or {}
        summary = dict(project_summary)
        summary["entry_files"] = project_summary.get("entry_files", [])
        return summary

    def _current_prefer_code(self) -> bool:
        return self.prefer_code_radio.isChecked()

    def _answer_deterministic(
            self,
            question: str,
            selected_model: str,
            merged_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
            memory_turns_override: list[ConversationTurn] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._last_bundle = merged_bundle
        self._last_selected_model = selected_model
        self._pending_question = question
        self._populate_evidence_lists(merged_bundle)

        summary = self._build_summary_payload()
        prefer_code = self._current_prefer_code()
        memory_turns = (
            memory_turns_override
            if memory_turns_override is not None
            else self.memory.turns()
        )

        prompt = self.prompt_builder.build(
            question=question,
            bundle=merged_bundle,
            project_root=self.project_index.project_root,
            summary=summary,
            memory_turns=memory_turns,
            prefer_code=prefer_code,
        )

        self._last_prompt = prompt
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(prompt)
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")
        self._append_log(
            "Answering with deterministic route via exact resolver / bridge fast path. "
            + "style="
            + ("prefer_code" if prefer_code else "prefer_prose")
        )

        self.ai.ask(prompt, selected_model)

    def _answer_ranked(
        self,
        question: str,
        selected_model: str,
        merged_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
    ) -> None:
        _ = question
        _ = selected_model

        self._last_bundle = merged_bundle
        self._last_selected_model = ""
        self._pending_question = ""
        self._last_prompt = ""

        self._populate_evidence_lists(merged_bundle)
        self.prompt_preview.clear()

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Ranked retrieval result")
        lines.append("")

        if merged_bundle.file_evidence:
            lines.append("Top file evidence:")
            for item in merged_bundle.file_evidence[:5]:
                lines.append(f"[{item.evidence_id}] {item.path} | score={item.score}")
        else:
            lines.append("Top file evidence:")
            lines.append("None")

        lines.append("")

        if merged_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            lines.append("Top symbol evidence:")
            for item in merged_bundle.symbol_evidence[:5]:
                lines.append(
                    f"[{item.evidence_id}] {item.symbol_name} @ {item.path}:{item.line} | score={item.score}"
                )
        else:
            lines.append("Top symbol evidence:")
            lines.append("None")

        self.answer_box.setPlainText("\n".join(lines))
        self._append_log("Answered using ranked retrieval only.")

            self,
            question: str,

    ) -> None:

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        self._save_last_config()
        super().closeEvent(event)

    def _restore_last_config(self) -> None:
        json_path = str(self.settings.value("json_path", "", type=str) or "")
        cache_dir = str(self.settings.value("cache_dir", "", type=str) or "")
        governance_path = str(self.settings.value("governance_path", "", type=str) or "")
        selected_model = str(self.settings.value("selected_model", "", type=str) or "")
        prefer_code = self.settings.value("prefer_code", True, type=bool)
        geometry = self.settings.value("window_geometry")

        if prefer_code:
            self.prefer_code_radio.setChecked(True)
        else:
            self.prefer_prose_radio.setChecked(True)

        if json_path:
            self.json_path_edit.setText(json_path)
            try:
                if os.path.exists(json_path):
                    self.project_index.load_json(json_path)
                    summary = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {})
                    self._append_log("Auto-loaded JSON: " + json_path)
                    self._append_log("Project root: " + self.project_index.project_root)
                    self._append_log("Python files: " + str(summary.get("python_file_count", "unknown")))
                    self._append_log("Entry files: " + str(summary.get("entry_file_count", "unknown")))
            except Exception as exc:
                self._append_log("Auto-load JSON failed: " + str(exc))

        if cache_dir:
            self.cache_dir_edit.setText(cache_dir)
            try:
                self.ai.set_cache_dir(cache_dir)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if governance_path:
            self.governance_path_edit.setText(governance_path)
            try:
                self.ai.set_governance_state_path(governance_path)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if selected_model:
            idx = self.model_combo.findText(selected_model)
            if idx >= 0:
                self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)

        if geometry is not None:
            try:
                self.restoreGeometry(geometry)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _save_last_config(self) -> None:
        if not getattr(self, "_settings_ready", False):
            return

        self.settings.setValue("json_path", self.json_path_edit.text().strip())
        self.settings.setValue("cache_dir", self.cache_dir_edit.text().strip())
        self.settings.setValue("governance_path", self.governance_path_edit.text().strip())
        self.settings.setValue("selected_model", self.model_combo.currentText().strip())
        self.settings.setValue("prefer_code", self.prefer_code_radio.isChecked())
        self.settings.setValue("window_geometry", self.saveGeometry())
        self.settings.sync()

        cursor.movePosition(QTextCursor.MoveOperation.End)
        cursor.insertText(token)
        self.answer_box.setTextCursor(cursor)
        self.answer_box.ensureCursorVisible()

        self.refresh_models_button.clicked.connect(self.refresh_models)

        self.quick_startup_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain startup chain for the app step by step.")
        )
        self.quick_topomap_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain topomap chain and how it is wired into the app.")
        )
        self.quick_timeline_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain timeline chain and the flow between timeline modules.")
        )
        self.quick_responsibility_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Create a responsibility map of the main modules in this app.")
        )
        self.quick_uncertainty_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Create an uncertainty report about the architecture based on current evidence.")
        )

        self.question_edit.returnPressed.connect(self.ask_local_ai)
        self.file_evidence_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_file_detail)
        self.symbol_evidence_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_symbol_detail)
        self.history_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_history_turn)

        self.ai.bridge.answer_ready.connect(self._on_ai_answer_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.token_ready.connect(self._on_ai_token_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.error_ready.connect(self._on_ai_error_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.status_ready.connect(self._append_log)

        self.model_combo.currentTextChanged.connect(self._save_last_config)
        self.prefer_code_radio.toggled.connect(self._save_last_config)
        self.prefer_prose_radio.toggled.connect(self._save_last_config)

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)

    def show_help_dialog(self) -> None:
        dialog = HelpDialog(self)
        dialog.exec()

    def refresh_models(self) -> None:
        self.model_combo.clear()
        models = self.model_registry.list_models()

        if not models:
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:7b")
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:32b")
            self._append_log("Could not verify models from Ollama. Added fallback model names.")
            self._save_last_config()
            return

        for model_name in models:
            self.model_combo.addItem(model_name)

        preferred = "qwen2.5-coder:7b"
        idx = self.model_combo.findText(preferred)
        if idx >= 0:
            self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)

        self._append_log("Verified models from Ollama: " + ", ".join(models))
        self._save_last_config()

    def clear_visuals_only(self) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")
        self.prompt_preview.clear()
        self.log_box.clear()
        self._last_bundle = RetrievalBundle([], [], [])
        self._last_prompt = ""

    def clear_memory(self) -> None:
        self.memory.clear()
        self.history_list.clear()
        self._append_log("Conversation memory cleared.")

    def _run_quick_question(self, question: str) -> None:
        self.question_edit.setText(question)
        self.ask_local_ai()

    def pick_cache_dir(self) -> None:
        path = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select cache directory")
        if not path:
            return
        self.cache_dir_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_cache_dir(path)
            self._append_log("Cache dir set: " + path)
            self._save_last_config()
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Cache dir error", str(exc))

    def pick_governance_path(self) -> None:
        path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select governance_state.json",
            os.getcwd(),
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        self.governance_path_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_governance_state_path(path)
            self._append_log("Governance state set: " + path)
            self._save_last_config()
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Governance path error", str(exc))

    def load_json(self) -> None:
        current_path = self.json_path_edit.text().strip()
        start_dir = os.path.dirname(current_path) if current_path else os.getcwd()

        file_path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select project_structure_index.json",
            start_dir,
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not file_path:
            return

        try:
            self.project_index.load_json(file_path)
            self.json_path_edit.setText(file_path)

            summary = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {})
            self._append_log("Loaded JSON: " + file_path)
            self._append_log("Project root: " + self.project_index.project_root)
            self._append_log("Python files: " + str(summary.get("python_file_count", "unknown")))
            self._append_log("Entry files: " + str(summary.get("entry_file_count", "unknown")))
            self._save_last_config()

            QMessageBox.information(self, "Loaded", "JSON loaded successfully.")
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", "Failed to load JSON:\n" + str(exc))

    def ask_local_ai(self) -> None:
        if not self.project_index.index_data:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No JSON", "Please load a JSON file first.")
            return

        question = self.question_edit.text().strip()
        if not question:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Question", "Please type a question.")
            return

        decision = route_query_intent(question)
        self._append_log(
            "Query route: " + decision.route
            + " | intent=" + decision.intent_name
            + " | reason=" + decision.reason
        )

        selected_model = self.model_combo.currentText().strip()
        if not selected_model:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Model", "Please select a model.")
            return

        current_bundle = self.retriever.retrieve(
            question,
            file_limit=10,
            symbol_limit=10,
            snippet_limit=6,
        )

        if not current_bundle.file_evidence and not current_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "No Evidence", "No relevant evidence was retrieved.")
            return

        debug_disable_previous_turn_merge = True

        if debug_disable_previous_turn_merge:
            merged_bundle = current_bundle
            memory_turns_override: list[ConversationTurn] = []
            self._append_log("Debug mode: previous-turn retrieval merge disabled.")
        else:
            previous_turn = self.memory.last_turn()
            if previous_turn is not None:
                merged_bundle = self.retriever.merge_with_previous(
                    current_bundle=current_bundle,
                    previous_bundle=previous_turn.retrieval,
                    max_files=14,
                    max_symbols=14,
                    max_snippets=10,
                )
            else:
                merged_bundle = current_bundle
            memory_turns_override = self.memory.turns()

        if decision.route == "deterministic":
            self._append_log("Answering with deterministic route.")
            self._answer_deterministic(
                question,
                selected_model,
                merged_bundle,
                memory_turns_override=memory_turns_override,
            )
            return

        if decision.route == "ranked":
            self._answer_ranked(question, selected_model, merged_bundle)
            return

        self._append_log("Answering with generative route using local model.")
        self._answer_generative(
            question,
            selected_model,
            merged_bundle,
            memory_turns_override=memory_turns_override,
        )

    def _populate_evidence_lists(self, bundle: RetrievalBundle) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        for item in bundle.file_evidence:
            label = "[" + item.evidence_id + "] " + shorten_path(item.path) + " | score=" + str(item.score)
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.file_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        for item in bundle.symbol_evidence:
            label = (
                "[" + item.evidence_id + "] "
                + item.symbol_name
                + " @ "
                + shorten_path(item.path, 70)
                + ":"
                + str(item.line)
            )
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.symbol_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        if bundle.file_evidence:
            self.file_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)
        elif bundle.symbol_evidence:
            self.symbol_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _show_selected_file_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.file_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_symbol_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_history_turn(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        row = self.history_list.row(current)
        turns = self.memory.turns()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(turns):
            return
        turn = turns[row]
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(turn.answer)
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(turn.prompt)

    def _refresh_history_list(self) -> None:
        self.history_list.clear()
        for idx, turn in enumerate(self.memory.turns(), start=1):
            label = str(idx) + ". " + turn.question
            item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            self.history_list.addItem(item)

    def _on_ai_answer_ready(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(text)
        self._append_log("Local AI answer received.")

        turn = ConversationTurn(
            question=self._pending_question,
            answer=text,
            prompt=self._last_prompt,
            retrieval=self._last_bundle,
            selected_model=self._last_selected_model,
        )
        self.memory.add_turn(turn)
        self._refresh_history_list()

    def _on_ai_error_ready(self, error_text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("AI error:\n" + error_text)
        self._append_log("AI error: " + error_text)


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = JsonProjectReasonerV9()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

I found three cleanup targets in this window module: one unused helper that still references self.idx, one fully commented legacy ask_local_ai, and some route-handling noise that can be simplified without changing behavior.

Here is the cleaned complete module.

def shorten_path(path: str, max_len: int = 90) -> str:
    if len(path) <= max_len:
        return path
    return "..." + path[-(max_len - 3):]


class CopyableListWidget(QListWidget):
    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setSelectionMode(QListWidget.ExtendedSelection)
        self.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.CustomContextMenu)
        self.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._show_context_menu)

    def _selected_text(self) -> str:
        items = self.selectedItems()
        if not items:
            current = self.currentItem()
            if current is None:
                return ""
            return current.text()
        return "\n".join(item.text() for item in items)

    def _all_text(self) -> str:
        return "\n".join(self.item(i).text() for i in range(self.count()))

    def copy_selected(self) -> None:
        text = self._selected_text()
        if text:
            QApplication.clipboard().setText(text)

    def copy_all(self) -> None:
        text = self._all_text()
        if text:
            QApplication.clipboard().setText(text)

    def _show_context_menu(self, pos) -> None:
        menu = QMenu(self)

        copy_selected_action = QAction("Copy Selected", self)
        copy_selected_action.triggered.connect(self.copy_selected)
        menu.addAction(copy_selected_action)

        copy_all_action = QAction("Copy All", self)
        copy_all_action.triggered.connect(self.copy_all)
        menu.addAction(copy_all_action)

        menu.exec(self.mapToGlobal(pos))

    def keyPressEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if event.matches(QKeySequence.Copy):
            self.copy_selected()
            event.accept()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)


class HelpDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(str(HELP_INDEX.get("window_title", "Help")))
        self.resize(1100, 800)

        self.section_list = CopyableListWidget()
        self.content_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.content_box.setReadOnly(True)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)

        left_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        left_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Sections"))
        left_panel.addWidget(self.section_list)

        right_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        right_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Help Content"))
        right_panel.addWidget(self.content_box)

        left_widget = QWidget()
        left_widget.setLayout(left_panel)

        right_widget = QWidget()
        right_widget.setLayout(right_panel)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(left_widget)
        splitter.addWidget(right_widget)
        splitter.setSizes([260, 780])

        layout.addWidget(splitter)

        self._populate_sections()
        self.section_list.currentRowChanged.connect(self._show_section)

        if self.section_list.count() > 0:
            self.section_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _populate_sections(self) -> None:
        for section in HELP_INDEX.get("sections", []):
            title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
            item = QListWidgetItem(title)
            item.setData(Qt.UserRole, section)
            self.section_list.addItem(item)

    def _show_section(self, row: int) -> None:
        item = self.section_list.item(row)
        if item is None:
            self.content_box.clear()
            return

        section = item.data(Qt.UserRole) or {}
        title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
        items = section.get("items", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append(title)
        lines.append("=" * len(title))
        lines.append("")

        for entry in items:
            label = str(entry.get("label", "Item"))
            lines.append(label)
            lines.append("-" * len(label))

            for key in [
                "purpose",
                "how_it_works",
                "best_use",
                "best_config",
                "what_it_is_for",
                "notes",
            ]:
                value = str(entry.get(key, "")).strip()
                if value:
                    pretty_key = key.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
                    lines.append(pretty_key + ":")
                    lines.append(value)
                    lines.append("")

        self.content_box.setPlainText("\n".join(lines).strip())


class JsonProjectReasonerV9(QMainWindow):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Project JSON Explorer V10 - Local AI Reasoner")
        self.resize(1880, 1080)

        self.project_index = JsonProjectIndex()
        self.retriever = ProjectRetriever(self.project_index)
        self.prompt_builder = PromptBuilder()
        self.ai = LocalAIReasoner()
        self.memory = ConversationMemory()
        self.model_registry = LocalModelRegistry()
        self.settings = QSettings("Kanda", "ProjectReasonerV10")
        self._settings_ready = False

        self._last_bundle = RetrievalBundle([], [], [])
        self._last_prompt = ""
        self._last_selected_model = ""
        self._pending_question = ""

        self.json_path_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.question_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.cache_dir_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.governance_path_edit = QLineEdit()

        self.model_combo = QComboBox()
        self.refresh_models_button = QPushButton("Refresh Models")
        self.help_button = QPushButton("Help (?)")
        self.help_button.setFixedWidth(80)

        self.load_button = QPushButton("Load JSON")
        self.ask_ai_button = QPushButton("Ask Local AI")
        self.clear_button = QPushButton("Clear")
        self.clear_memory_button = QPushButton("Clear Memory")
        self.pick_cache_dir_button = QPushButton("Set Cache Dir")
        self.pick_governance_button = QPushButton("Set Governance State")

        self.quick_startup_button = QPushButton("Explain startup chain")
        self.quick_topomap_button = QPushButton("Explain topomap chain")
        self.quick_timeline_button = QPushButton("Explain timeline chain")
        self.quick_responsibility_button = QPushButton("Responsibility map")
        self.quick_uncertainty_button = QPushButton("Uncertainty report")

        self.prefer_code_radio = QRadioButton("Prefer code")
        self.prefer_prose_radio = QRadioButton("Prefer prose")
        self.answer_style_group = QButtonGroup(self)
        self.answer_style_group.setExclusive(True)
        self.answer_style_group.addButton(self.prefer_code_radio)
        self.answer_style_group.addButton(self.prefer_prose_radio)
        self.prefer_code_radio.setChecked(True)

        self.file_evidence_list = CopyableListWidget()
        self.symbol_evidence_list = CopyableListWidget()
        self.history_list = CopyableListWidget()

        self.detail_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.detail_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self.answer_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.answer_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self.prompt_preview = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.prompt_preview.setReadOnly(True)

        self.log_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.log_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()
        self.refresh_models()
        self._restore_last_config()
        self._settings_ready = True

    def _build_summary_payload(self) -> dict:
        project_summary = self.project_index.project_summary or {}
        summary = dict(project_summary)
        summary["entry_files"] = project_summary.get("entry_files", [])
        return summary

    def _current_prefer_code(self) -> bool:
        return self.prefer_code_radio.isChecked()

    def _answer_deterministic(
        self,
        question: str,
        selected_model: str,
        merged_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        memory_turns_override: list[ConversationTurn] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._last_bundle = merged_bundle
        self._last_selected_model = selected_model
        self._pending_question = question
        self._populate_evidence_lists(merged_bundle)

        summary = self._build_summary_payload()
        prefer_code = self._current_prefer_code()
        memory_turns = (
            memory_turns_override
            if memory_turns_override is not None
            else self.memory.turns()
        )

        prompt = self.prompt_builder.build(
            question=question,
            bundle=merged_bundle,
            project_root=self.project_index.project_root,
            summary=summary,
            memory_turns=memory_turns,
            prefer_code=prefer_code,
        )

        self._last_prompt = prompt
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(prompt)
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")
        self._append_log(
            "Answering with deterministic route via exact resolver / bridge fast path. "
            + "style="
            + ("prefer_code" if prefer_code else "prefer_prose")
        )

        self.ai.ask(prompt, selected_model)

    def _answer_ranked(
        self,
        question: str,
        selected_model: str,
        merged_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
    ) -> None:
        _ = question
        _ = selected_model

        self._last_bundle = merged_bundle
        self._last_selected_model = ""
        self._pending_question = ""
        self._last_prompt = ""

        self._populate_evidence_lists(merged_bundle)
        self.prompt_preview.clear()

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Ranked retrieval result")
        lines.append("")

        if merged_bundle.file_evidence:
            lines.append("Top file evidence:")
            for item in merged_bundle.file_evidence[:5]:
                lines.append(f"[{item.evidence_id}] {item.path} | score={item.score}")
        else:
            lines.append("Top file evidence:")
            lines.append("None")

        lines.append("")

        if merged_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            lines.append("Top symbol evidence:")
            for item in merged_bundle.symbol_evidence[:5]:
                lines.append(
                    f"[{item.evidence_id}] {item.symbol_name} @ {item.path}:{item.line} | score={item.score}"
                )
        else:
            lines.append("Top symbol evidence:")
            lines.append("None")

        self.answer_box.setPlainText("\n".join(lines))
        self._append_log("Answered using ranked retrieval only.")

    def _answer_generative(
        self,
        question: str,
        selected_model: str,
        merged_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        memory_turns_override: list[ConversationTurn] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._last_bundle = merged_bundle
        self._last_selected_model = selected_model
        self._pending_question = question
        self._populate_evidence_lists(merged_bundle)

        summary = self._build_summary_payload()
        prefer_code = self._current_prefer_code()
        memory_turns = (
            memory_turns_override
            if memory_turns_override is not None
            else self.memory.turns()
        )

        prompt = self.prompt_builder.build(
            question=question,
            bundle=merged_bundle,
            project_root=self.project_index.project_root,
            summary=summary,
            memory_turns=memory_turns,
            prefer_code=prefer_code,
        )

        self._last_prompt = prompt
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(prompt)
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")
        self._append_log(
            "Answering with generative route using local model. "
            + "style="
            + ("prefer_code" if prefer_code else "prefer_prose")
        )

        self.ai.ask(prompt, selected_model)

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        self._save_last_config()
        super().closeEvent(event)

    def _restore_last_config(self) -> None:
        json_path = str(self.settings.value("json_path", "", type=str) or "")
        cache_dir = str(self.settings.value("cache_dir", "", type=str) or "")
        governance_path = str(self.settings.value("governance_path", "", type=str) or "")
        selected_model = str(self.settings.value("selected_model", "", type=str) or "")
        prefer_code = self.settings.value("prefer_code", True, type=bool)
        geometry = self.settings.value("window_geometry")

        if prefer_code:
            self.prefer_code_radio.setChecked(True)
        else:
            self.prefer_prose_radio.setChecked(True)

        if json_path:
            self.json_path_edit.setText(json_path)
            try:
                if os.path.exists(json_path):
                    self.project_index.load_json(json_path)
                    summary = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {})
                    self._append_log("Auto-loaded JSON: " + json_path)
                    self._append_log("Project root: " + self.project_index.project_root)
                    self._append_log("Python files: " + str(summary.get("python_file_count", "unknown")))
                    self._append_log("Entry files: " + str(summary.get("entry_file_count", "unknown")))
            except Exception as exc:
                self._append_log("Auto-load JSON failed: " + str(exc))

        if cache_dir:
            self.cache_dir_edit.setText(cache_dir)
            try:
                self.ai.set_cache_dir(cache_dir)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if governance_path:
            self.governance_path_edit.setText(governance_path)
            try:
                self.ai.set_governance_state_path(governance_path)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if selected_model:
            idx = self.model_combo.findText(selected_model)
            if idx >= 0:
                self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)

        if geometry is not None:
            try:
                self.restoreGeometry(geometry)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _save_last_config(self) -> None:
        if not getattr(self, "_settings_ready", False):
            return

        self.settings.setValue("json_path", self.json_path_edit.text().strip())
        self.settings.setValue("cache_dir", self.cache_dir_edit.text().strip())
        self.settings.setValue("governance_path", self.governance_path_edit.text().strip())
        self.settings.setValue("selected_model", self.model_combo.currentText().strip())
        self.settings.setValue("prefer_code", self.prefer_code_radio.isChecked())
        self.settings.setValue("window_geometry", self.saveGeometry())
        self.settings.sync()

    def _on_ai_token_ready(self, token: str) -> None:
        current = self.answer_box.toPlainText()
        if current == "[Streaming...]\n\n":
            self.answer_box.setPlainText("")

        cursor = self.answer_box.textCursor()
        cursor.movePosition(QTextCursor.MoveOperation.End)
        cursor.insertText(token)
        self.answer_box.setTextCursor(cursor)
        self.answer_box.ensureCursorVisible()

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:

    def show_help_dialog(self) -> None:
